```python
"""Pollinations.ai (free, no key) image helper."""
import time
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path

import requests

BASE = "https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/"
STYLE = "flat 2D cartoon, thick bold black outlines, warm colors, clean vector look, plain white background"


def generate(prompt: str, out: Path, width=768, height=768, seed=42, retries=4) -> Path:
    url = BASE + urllib.parse.quote(f"{prompt}, {STYLE}")
    params = {"width": width, "height": height, "seed": seed, "nologo": "true"}
    for attempt in range(retries):
        r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=180)
        if r.ok and r.headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith("image"):
            out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            out.write_bytes(r.content)
            return out
        wait = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", 60))
        print(f"  {r.status_code} {r.text[:120]!r} -> retry in {wait}s")
        time.sleep(wait)
    raise RuntimeError(f"Pollinations failed for {out.name}")

```

```python
"""Generate reference sheets for the 4 permanent characters (bible section 2)."""
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from pollinations import generate  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / "characters"
SHEET = "character turnaround sheet of ONE single character, front view, side view, three facial expressions (happy, surprised, thinking)"

CHARACTERS = {
    "dadi": "elderly Indian grandmother about 70 years old, round face, white hair tied in a bun, round golden spectacles, "
            "light green saree with border, wooden walking stick, small red bindi on forehead, kind wise smile",
    "golu": "chubby Indian boy about 10 years old, round face, messy black hair, yellow t-shirt, blue half pants, red shoes",
    "mitthu": "cute green parrot with red beak, small round eyes",
    "pandey": "fat Indian police inspector about 45 years old, khaki police uniform with belt and cap, thick bushy black moustache",
}

SEEDS = {"dadi": 101, "golu": 202, "mitthu": 303, "pandey": 404}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    names = sys.argv[1:] or list(CHARACTERS)
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        if i:
            time.sleep(47)  # free tier: 1 image / 45s per IP
        out = OUT / f"{name}_sheet.png"
        generate(f"{SHEET}, {CHARACTERS[name]}", out, width=768, height=768, seed=SEEDS[name])
        print("saved", out)

```

Step 1 ho gaya hai aur Step 2 bhi chal gaya, lekin free images is kaam ke laayak nahi nikli. Main yahin ruka hoon, aage badhne se pehle aapka faisla chahiye.

## Step 1 — Setup
- Folders ban gaye: `scripts/`, `images/`, `audio/`, `output/`, `characters/`, `tools/`. Saath me maine `cases/`, `assets/fonts/` aur `assets/music/` bhi banaye hain, ye aage kaam aayenge.
- `.venv` me edge-tts, requests, pillow aur python-dotenv install ho gaye.
- FFmpeg chal raha hai aur `tools/ffmpeg/` me rakha hai (ffmpeg, ffprobe, ffplay). gyan.dev bahut dheema tha, isliye ye GitHub (BtbN build) se liya.
- [.gitignore](.gitignore) me aapki saari entries hain, aur `.venv/` bhi daal diya hai.
- [channel_bible.md](channel_bible.md) aur [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) pehle hi ban chuke the.

## Step 2 — Pollinations ki terms
- **Commercial use: saaf jawab nahi mila.** Official terms bas itna kehti hain ki har model ka licence alag hai aur commercial use se pehle khud check karo. Website ki terms wali page bhi theek se load nahi hui. Matlab monetized channel ke liye koi pakki guarantee nahi hai.
- **Bina key ke sirf ek purana model milta hai ("sana").** Max size 768×768 hai, har 45 sec me sirf ek image banti hai, aur `nologo` dene ke baad bhi har image par "pollinations.ai" ka logo aata hai.
- Flux, Gemini aur GPT-image jaise achhe models ke liye Pollinations ki secret key aur "pollen" credits chahiye.

## Step 2 — Reference sheets (result: fail)
Images yahan hain:
- `D:\Story-Channel\characters\dadi_sheet.png`
- `D:\Story-Channel\characters\golu_sheet.png`
- `D:\Story-Channel\characters\mitthu_sheet.png`
- `D:\Story-Channel\characters\pandey_sheet.png`

**Ek bhi character ka chehra same nahi aaya:**
- **Dadi:** sirf ek painted portrait bana. Na front/side view hai, na chhadi, na saree.
- **Golu:** 9 alag-alag bachche bane. Ek ke baal peele hain, aur T-shirt ka rang har jagah alag hai.
- **Mitthu:** zyadatar kaale pakshi bane, tota nahi lagta.
- **Pandey:** 6 alag aadmi bane, kuch ki moonchh hi nahi hai, aur uniform kaali hai, khaki nahi.

Kisi bhi image me flat 2D style ya moti outlines nahi aayi. Sabse badi baat: ye model reference image le hi nahi sakta. Isliye aage ke scenes me bhi chehra same rakhna mumkin nahi hai.

## Aapka faisla chahiye
Aapke plan ke hisaab se ab **paid Gemini API** par jaana chahiye. Gemini reference image leta hai, toh har scene me chehra same aa sakta hai. Abhi tak ek rupaya bhi kharch nahi hua hai.

Agar aap haan kahein, toh:
1. Main Gemini image model ka **abhi ka exact rate** check karke batata hoon, aur ye bhi ki ek Short (4 sheets + 8-10 scenes) me lagbhag kitna kharcha aayega.
2. Aap `.env` file me `GEMINI_API_KEY=...` daal dijiye. Main key kabhi nahi dekhunga aur na kahin bhejunga.
3. Aapke final OK ke baad hi pehli paid image banegi.

Pichhle sawal ka jawab abhi bhi chahiye: **Dadi ki saree ki "pali border" ka rang kya hai, peela?** Paid images shuru karne se pehle ye fix hona chahiye.

Sources: [Pollinations Terms](https://enter.pollinations.ai/terms), [Pollinations API docs](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/APIDOCS.md), [gen.pollinations.ai/docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs), [Miraheze wiki](https://ai.miraheze.org/wiki/Pollinations), [ToolJunction review](https://www.tooljunction.io/ai-tools/pollinations), [FindMyAITool](https://findmyaitool.com/tool/pollinations)

````text
**Recommended image model IDs** (from the model selection section):
- `gemini-nano-banana-2.1`: the primary model for new projects
- `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`: fastest and cheapest, 1K only
- `gemini-3.1-flash-image`: previous generation; the page recommends 2.1 for new projects
- `gemini-3-pro-image`: for the most complex tasks
- `gemini-2.5-flash-image`: legacy

**Endpoint:** `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions`, with the header `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`.

**Request with reference images:** The page uses the Interactions API, not `inline_data` or `imageConfig`. Reference images go in the `input` array as `image` blocks with base64 `data`:

```json
{
  "model": "gemini-nano-banana-2.1",
  "input": [
    {"type": "text", "text": "An office group photo of these people, they are making funny faces."},
    {"type": "image", "mime_type": "image/png", "data": "<BASE64_DATA_IMG_1>"},
    {"type": "image", "mime_type": "image/png", "data": "<BASE64_DATA_IMG_2>"}
  ],
  "response_format": {"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "5:4", "image_size": "2K"}
}
```

**Aspect ratio and size:** Set these in `response_format` with the `aspect_ratio` and `image_size` fields. Use an uppercase K (`1K`, `2K`, `4K`); lowercase values are rejected. Gemini 3 image models default to 1K. The 512px (0.5K) size is available only on `gemini-3.1-flash-image`, and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` supports only 1K.

**Maximum reference images:** Up to 14 in total. The per-model breakdown is partly unclear in the page's table, but for `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` and `gemini-3.1-flash-image` it lists up to 10 object images and up to 5 character images. `gemini-3-pro-image` allows up to 6 object images, up to 5 character images, and up to 3 style references. The Lite model is not optimized for multiple reference inputs.

**Response format:** The image is returned as base64 in `output_image.data`, for example `base64.b64decode(interaction.output_image.data)` in Python. For interleaved output, iterate over `steps`, where `model_output` content blocks of type `image` carry a `data` field. The page does not mention `inlineData`.

**SynthID:** All generated images include a SynthID watermark.
````

```python
"""Gemini (Nano Banana) image helper. Key is read from .env and never printed."""
import base64
import mimetypes
import os
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")

ENDPOINT = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions"
MODEL = "gemini-nano-banana-2.1"
STYLE = ("Art style: flat 2D cartoon, thick bold black outlines, warm colours, flat cel shading, "
         "no gradients, no realism, clean vector look, kid-friendly.")


def _find_image(obj):
    """Return base64 image data from anywhere in the response JSON."""
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        if obj.get("type") == "image" and obj.get("data"):
            return obj["data"]
        if "output_image" in obj and isinstance(obj["output_image"], dict) and obj["output_image"].get("data"):
            return obj["output_image"]["data"]
        if "inlineData" in obj and obj["inlineData"].get("data"):
            return obj["inlineData"]["data"]
        for v in obj.values():
            found = _find_image(v)
            if found:
                return found
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj:
            found = _find_image(v)
            if found:
                return found
    return None


def generate(prompt: str, out: Path, refs: list[Path] = (), aspect_ratio="1:1", size="1K") -> Path:
    key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("GEMINI_API_KEY missing in .env")

    inputs = [{"type": "text", "text": f"{prompt}\n\n{STYLE}"}]
    for ref in refs:
        mime = mimetypes.guess_type(ref)[0] or "image/png"
        inputs.append({"type": "image", "mime_type": mime,
                       "data": base64.b64encode(Path(ref).read_bytes()).decode()})

    body = {"model": MODEL, "input": inputs,
            "response_format": {"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio, "image_size": size}}
    r = requests.post(ENDPOINT, json=body, headers={"x-goog-api-key": key}, timeout=300)
    if not r.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini {r.status_code}: {r.text[:500]}")

    data = _find_image(r.json())
    if not data:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No image in response: {r.text[:500]}")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data))
    return out

```

```python
"""Track Gemini image spend against the prepaid budget in cost_log.csv."""
import csv
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
LOG = ROOT / "cost_log.csv"

BUDGET_INR = 500.0
USD_TO_INR = 96.5  # mid-market rate checked 2026-10-17; update if it drifts

# USD per output image (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, checked 2026-10-17)
RATES_USD = {
    ("gemini-nano-banana-2.1", "1K"): 0.0336,
    ("gemini-nano-banana-2.1", "2K"): 0.0504,
    ("gemini-nano-banana-2.1", "4K"): 0.113,
}

FIELDS = ["timestamp", "file", "model", "size", "cost_usd", "cost_inr", "today_total_inr", "remaining_inr"]


def _rows():
    if not LOG.exists():
        return []
    with LOG.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def record(file: Path, model: str, size: str, when: datetime | None = None) -> dict:
    when = when or datetime.now()
    usd = RATES_USD[(model, size)]
    inr = usd * USD_TO_INR
    rows = _rows()
    today = when.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    today_total = inr + sum(float(r["cost_inr"]) for r in rows if r["timestamp"].startswith(today))
    spent = inr + sum(float(r["cost_inr"]) for r in rows)
    row = {
        "timestamp": when.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "file": Path(file).resolve().relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
        "model": model,
        "size": size,
        "cost_usd": f"{usd:.4f}",
        "cost_inr": f"{inr:.2f}",
        "today_total_inr": f"{today_total:.2f}",
        "remaining_inr": f"{BUDGET_INR - spent:.2f}",
    }
    new = not LOG.exists()
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=FIELDS)
        if new:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row


def summary(row: dict) -> str:
    return (f"Is image ka cost: ₹{row['cost_inr']}  |  Aaj ka total: ₹{row['today_total_inr']}  |  "
            f"₹{BUDGET_INR:.0f} me se bacha: ₹{row['remaining_inr']}")

```

```python
"""Build PREVIEW.md (image gallery with costs) and open images inside VS Code.

Usage:  python scripts/preview.py            rebuild PREVIEW.md and open its Markdown preview
        python scripts/preview.py <image>    open one image in a VS Code tab
"""
import csv
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PREVIEW = ROOT / "PREVIEW.md"
SECTIONS = [("Characters", ROOT / "characters"), ("Scenes", ROOT / "images")]


def _costs():
    log = ROOT / "cost_log.csv"
    if not log.exists():
        return {}, None
    with log.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    return {r["file"]: r for r in rows}, (rows[-1] if rows else None)


def build() -> Path:
    costs, last = _costs()
    lines = ["# Preview — दादी जासूस", ""]
    if last:
        lines += [f"**Budget bacha:** ₹{last['remaining_inr']}  ·  **Last image:** {last['timestamp']}", ""]
    for title, folder in SECTIONS:
        imgs = sorted(p for p in folder.rglob("*.png") if not any(part.startswith("_") for part in p.relative_to(folder).parts))
        if not imgs:
            continue
        lines += [f"## {title}", ""]
        for img in imgs:
            rel = img.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
            c = costs.get(rel)
            meta = f" — ₹{c['cost_inr']} · {c['timestamp']}" if c else ""
            lines += [f"### {img.stem}{meta}", "", f"![{img.stem}]({rel})", ""]
    PREVIEW.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    return PREVIEW


def open_in_vscode(path: Path):
    if os.environ.get("AUTO_PREVIEW", "1") == "0":
        return
    code = shutil.which("code")
    if code:
        subprocess.run([code, "--reuse-window", str(path)], check=False, shell=os.name == "nt")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        open_in_vscode(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())
    else:
        open_in_vscode(build())

```

```markdown
**शर्मा जी:** कल ही ख़रीदी थी! रात को गेट से बाँधी थी... और गेट पर कल ही लाल पेंट करवाया था!
```

```markdown
गेट पर कल ही लाल पेंट हुआ था और वो अभी भी गीला था (बोर्ड और मिठ्ठू का "गीला! गीला!")। ताला तोड़ने वाले ने गेट ज़रूर पकड़ा होगा, और सिर्फ़ बंटी की उंगलियों पर लाल रंग था (Scene 5 और 10)। पप्पू का गमछा तो हमेशा लाल रहता है, और राजू की उंगलियाँ केतली की कालिख से काली थीं।

**सीख:** जल्दबाज़ी में किसी पर इल्ज़ाम मत लगाओ, सबूत देखो।
```

Case 01 ka script, 10 scenes ki list aur answer teeno taiyaar hain. Abhi koi image nahi banayi, kharcha ₹0.

## Script: शर्मा जी की नई साइकिल
**123 shabd** (110-140 ke andar), lagbhag 50-55 sec

> **नैरेटर** *(hook)*: शर्मा जी की नई साइकिल... रातों-रात गायब!
>
> **शर्मा जी:** कल ही ख़रीदी थी! रात को गेट से बाँधी थी... और गेट पर कल ही लाल पेंट करवाया था!
>
> **नैरेटर:** शक तीन लोगों पर। पप्पू दूधवाला, जो रोज़ सबसे पहले यहाँ से गुज़रता है। राजू चायवाला, जिसने कल कहा था, "ऐसी साइकिल मुझे भी चाहिए।" और बंटी, जो कॉलेज के लिए साइकिल ढूँढ रहा था।
>
> **गोलू:** दादी, मुझे पता है चोर कौन है! पप्पू! देखो, उसका गमछा लाल है!
>
> **इंस्पेक्टर पांडे:** पकड़ो इसे!
>
> **दादी:** रुकिए पांडे जी। गमछा तो पप्पू रोज़ पहनता है। *(गेट छूकर)* पेंट अभी भी गीला है... जिसने ताला तोड़ा, उसके हाथ पर रंग ज़रूर लगा होगा।
>
> **मिठ्ठू:** गीला! गीला!
>
> **दादी:** बेटा, चोर कितना भी चालाक हो... दादी से नहीं बच सकता!
>
> **नैरेटर:** आपने ध्यान से देखा? बताओ, दोषी कौन? जवाब कमेंट में!

**Bible ke hisaab se:**
- Golu ka galat guess: laal gamchha dekh kar Pappu ko chor bolta hai.
- Dadi ka clue: gate ka paint geela hai, toh chor ke haath par rang hoga.
- Pandey galat aadmi (Pappu) ko pakadta hai.
- Mitthu "गीला" dohrata hai, jo clue hai.
- **Clue dikhta hai:** Bunty ki ungliyon par laal rang Scene 5 aur 10 me saaf nazar aayega.

**Answer** ([answer.md](cases/case01_cycle_chori/answer.md)): Chor **Bunty** hai. Paint geela tha, aur sirf Bunty ki ungliyon par laal rang tha. Pappu ka gamchha toh hamesha laal rehta hai, aur Raju ki ungliyan ketli ki kaalikh se kaali thi. Seekh: jaldbaazi me ilzaam mat lagao, saboot dekho.

## Scenes (10)
| # | Characters | Kya ho raha hai | Line |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sharma ji | Laal gate, "गीला पेंट" board, toota taala, cycle gayab | Hook |
| 2 | Sharma ji | Toota taala haath me, peeche geela gate | "कल ही ख़रीदी थी..." |
| 3 | Pappu | Cycle par doodh ke dibbe, laal gamchha, **saaf haath** | "पप्पू दूधवाला..." |
| 4 | Raju | Ketli se chai daalta, **kaali ungliyan** | "राजू चायवाला..." |
| 5 | Bunty | Sar khujata, **ungliyon par laal nishaan** | "और बंटी..." |
| 6 | Golu, Dadi, Pappu | Golu gamchhe ki taraf ungli karta hai | Golu ka guess |
| 7 | Pandey, Pappu | Pandey Pappu ko pakadta hai, doodh ka dibba hilta hai | "पकड़ो इसे!" |
| 8 | Dadi, Pandey, Mitthu | Dadi gate chhooti hai, **uski ungli laal** ho jaati hai | Dadi ka clue |
| 9 | Mitthu, Dadi | Mitthu "गीला! गीला!", Dadi ka catchphrase | |
| 10 | Teeno suspects | Line me khade, **haath dikhte hue**, upar "बताओ, दोषी कौन?" | Final sawal |

Poori list, har scene ka time, aur naye characters ke fixed look [scenes.md](cases/case01_cycle_chori/scenes.md) me hain. Naye characters me Sharma ji, Pappu, Raju, Bunty, cycle aur gate shamil hain.

**Aapka faisla chahiye:**
1. Bible me teen side characters ka look adhoora tha, isliye maine khud tay kiya hai (scenes.md ki table dekhiye):
   - Sharma ji: cream kurta, bhoori jacket
   - Pappu: patla
   - Raju: bhoori shirt, apron

   Theek lage toh inhe bible me bhi daal doon?
2. **Risk:** pura puzzle haathon ke rang par tika hai. Agar Gemini ungliyon ka laal rang saaf nahi banata, toh Scene 5, 8 ya 10 dobara banana pad sakta hai (har baar ~₹3.24).

Approve karne par Step 4 ki taraf badhunga: 10 scene images (~₹32.40), phir voice aur video. Images shuru karne se pehle ek baar poochunga.

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```python
"""Generate scene images for a case from cases/<case>/scene_prompts.json.

Usage:  python scripts/gen_scenes.py case01_cycle_chori          all scenes
        python scripts/gen_scenes.py case01_cycle_chori 5 8 10   only these
Refs: a permanent character name -> characters/<name>_sheet.png, "scene:N" -> an earlier scene image.
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from gemini_image import generate  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def ref_path(ref: str, out_dir: Path) -> Path:
    if ref.startswith("scene:"):
        return out_dir / f"scene_{int(ref[6:]):02d}.png"
    return ROOT / "characters" / f"{ref}_sheet.png"


def main(case: str, only: list[int]):
    spec = json.loads((ROOT / "cases" / case / "scene_prompts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    out_dir = ROOT / "images" / case
    for scene in spec["scenes"]:
        if only and scene["id"] not in only:
            continue
        refs = [ref_path(r, out_dir) for r in scene["refs"]]
        missing = [r for r in refs if not r.exists()]
        if missing:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Scene {scene['id']} needs {missing}")
        prompt = scene["prompt"].format(**spec["looks"])
        if refs:
            prompt += ("\n\nThe attached images are approved references. Keep every character's face, body, "
                       "outfit and colours EXACTLY as in the references, and match their art style.")
        out = out_dir / f"scene_{scene['id']:02d}.png"
        generate(f"{spec['base']}\n\n{prompt}", out, refs=refs, aspect_ratio="9:16", size="1K")
        print("saved", out, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], [int(x) for x in sys.argv[2:]])

```

```python
"""Synthesise our own light 'tiptoe mystery' music bed (no third-party audio -> no copyright risk).

Usage: python scripts/gen_music.py [seconds]   -> assets/music/mystery_bed.wav
"""
import sys
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

SR = 44100
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / "assets" / "music" / "mystery_bed.wav"
BPM = 104
BEAT = 60 / BPM


def midi_hz(n):
    return 440.0 * 2 ** ((n - 69) / 12)


def pluck(freq, dur, rng, bright=0.5):
    """Karplus-Strong plucked string (pizzicato feel)."""
    n = int(SR * dur)
    period = max(2, int(SR / freq))
    buf = rng.uniform(-1, 1, period)
    out = np.empty(n)
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = buf[i % period]
        buf[i % period] = 0.996 * (bright * buf[i % period] + (1 - bright) * buf[(i + 1) % period])
    return out * np.exp(-np.linspace(0, 6, n))


def pad(freqs, dur):
    t = np.arange(int(SR * dur)) / SR
    sig = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2.003 * f * t) for f in freqs)
    env = np.minimum(1, t / 0.8) * np.minimum(1, (dur - t) / 0.8)
    return sig * env / len(freqs)


def tick(dur=0.05):
    t = np.arange(int(SR * dur)) / SR
    return np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1800 * t) * np.exp(-t * 90)


def render(seconds: float) -> np.ndarray:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    total = int(SR * (seconds + 2))
    mix = np.zeros(total)

    def add(sig, at):
        i = int(at * SR)
        j = min(total, i + len(sig))
        if i < total:
            mix[i:j] += sig[: j - i]

    # D minor-ish sneaky pattern: 4 bars, repeated
    chords = [(50, 53, 57), (46, 50, 53), (48, 52, 55), (45, 49, 52)]  # Dm, Bb, C, A
    melody = [62, None, 65, 64, 62, None, 60, 57,
              58, None, 62, 60, 58, None, 57, 55,
              60, None, 64, 62, 60, None, 59, 55,
              57, None, 61, 64, 62, None, None, None]
    bar = 4 * BEAT
    t = 0.0
    step = 0
    while t < seconds:
        bar_i = step // 8 % 4
        if step % 8 == 0:
            add(0.10 * pad([midi_hz(n) for n in chords[bar_i]], bar), t)
            add(0.55 * pluck(midi_hz(chords[bar_i][0] - 12), bar * 0.9, rng, 0.3), t)  # bass
        if step % 2 == 0:
            add(0.05 * tick(), t)  # clock tick
        note = melody[step % 32]
        if note is not None:
            add(0.35 * pluck(midi_hz(note), BEAT * 1.5, rng, 0.6), t)
        t += BEAT / 2
        step += 1

    mix = mix[: int(SR * seconds)]
    fade = int(SR * 1.5)
    mix[:fade] *= np.linspace(0, 1, fade)
    mix[-fade:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, fade)
    return mix / (np.abs(mix).max() + 1e-9) * 0.7


def main(seconds=70.0):
    mono = render(seconds)
    # gentle stereo: tiny delay on right channel
    d = int(SR * 0.012)
    right = np.concatenate([np.zeros(d), mono[:-d]])
    stereo = (np.stack([mono, right], axis=1) * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with wave.open(str(OUT), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(2)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(SR)
        w.writeframes(stereo.tobytes())
    print("saved", OUT)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 70.0)

```

```python
VOICES = {
    "narrator": ("hi-IN-MadhurNeural", "+5%", "+0Hz"),
    "sharma": ("hi-IN-MadhurNeural", "+10%", "+8Hz"),
    "pandey": ("hi-IN-MadhurNeural", "-5%", "-14Hz"),
    "golu": ("hi-IN-SwaraNeural", "+15%", "+28Hz"),
    "dadi": ("hi-IN-SwaraNeural", "-8%", "-14Hz"),
    "mitthu": ("hi-IN-SwaraNeural", "+25%", "+70Hz"),
}

# Ken Burns move per scene (cycled): zoom-in, pan, zoom-out, zoom-to-top
MOVES = {
    "in": ("1+0.08*on/{n}", "iw/2-iw/zoom/2", "ih/2-ih/zoom/2"),
    "out": ("1.08-0.08*on/{n}", "iw/2-iw/zoom/2", "ih/2-ih/zoom/2"),
    "pan": ("1.08", "(iw-iw/zoom)*on/{n}", "ih/2-ih/zoom/2"),
    "top": ("1+0.08*on/{n}", "iw/2-iw/zoom/2", "(ih-ih/zoom)*0.3"),
}
MOVE_CYCLE = ["in", "pan", "out", "top"]


def run(args, cwd=None):
    r = subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"FAILED: {' '.join(map(str, args))[:300]}\n{r.stderr[-2000:]}")
    return r


# ---------- 1. voice ----------
async def tts(text, speaker, mp3: Path):
    voice, rate, pitch = VOICES[speaker]
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            words, audio = [], bytearray()
            comm = edge_tts.Communicate(text, voice, rate=rate, pitch=pitch, boundary="WordBoundary")
            async for ch in comm.stream():
                if ch["type"] == "audio":
                    audio += ch["data"]
                elif ch["type"] == "WordBoundary":
                    s = ch["offset"] / 1e7
                    words.append((s, s + ch["duration"] / 1e7, ch["text"]))
            mp3.write_bytes(audio)
            return words
        except Exception as e:  # network hiccup
            print(f"  tts retry ({e})")
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
    sys.exit(f"TTS failed: {text}")


def wav_pcm(mp3: Path, wav: Path):
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", mp3, "-ac", "1", "-ar", SR, "-sample_fmt", "s16", wav])
    with wave.open(str(wav)) as w:
        return w.readframes(w.getnframes())


def build_voice(lines, audio_dir: Path, work: Path):
    pcm, t = bytearray(), 0.0
    silence = lambda sec: b"\x00\x00" * int(round(sec * SR))
    scene_start, timed = {}, []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        mp3 = audio_dir / f"line_{i + 1:02d}_{line['speaker']}.mp3"
        words = asyncio.run(tts(line["text"], line["speaker"], mp3))
        data = wav_pcm(mp3, work / f"line_{i + 1:02d}.wav")
        if i:
            gap = LINE_GAP
            if line["scene"] != lines[i - 1]["scene"]:
                gap = max(SCENE_GAP, MIN_SCENE - (t - scene_start[lines[i - 1]["scene"]]))
            pcm += silence(gap)
            t += gap
        if line["scene"] not in scene_start:
            scene_start[line["scene"]] = 0.0 if i == 0 else t - 0.15
        timed.append({**line, "start": t, "words": [(t + a, t + b, w) for a, b, w in words]})
        pcm += data
        t += len(data) / 2 / SR
        print(f"  line {i + 1:2d} [{line['speaker']:8s}] {len(data) / 2 / SR:5.2f}s")
    pcm += silence(END_HOLD)
    total = len(pcm) / 2 / SR
    voice = work / "voice.wav"
    with wave.open(str(voice), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1), w.setsampwidth(2), w.setframerate(SR), w.writeframes(bytes(pcm))
    return voice, total, scene_start, timed


# ---------- 2. captions ----------
def ass_time(s):
    cs = int(round(s * 100))
    return f"{cs // 360000}:{cs // 6000 % 60:02d}:{cs // 100 % 60:02d}.{cs % 100:02d}"


def build_ass(timed, scene_start, total, final_scene, final_title, font_family, path: Path):
    events = []
    for line in timed:
        tokens = line["text"].split()
        words = line["words"]
        if len(tokens) != len(words):  # fall back to TTS tokens if counts differ
            tokens = [w for _, _, w in words]
        chunks, cur = [], []
        for tok, (s, e, _) in zip(tokens, words):
            cur.append((tok, s, e))
            if len(cur) == 3 or re.search(r"[।!?,.…]$", tok):
                chunks.append(cur)
                cur = []
        if cur:
            chunks.append(cur)
        for k, ch in enumerate(chunks):
            start = ch[0][1]
            end = chunks[k + 1][0][1] if k + 1 < len(chunks) else ch[-1][2] + 0.35
            text = " ".join(tok for tok, _, _ in ch)
            events.append(f"Dialogue: 0,{ass_time(start)},{ass_time(end)},Cap,,0,0,0,,{text}")
    if final_title:
        events.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{ass_time(scene_start[final_scene])},{ass_time(total)},Title,,0,0,0,,"
                      f"{{\\fad(300,0)}}{final_title}")
    path.write_text(f"""[Script Info]
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: {W}
PlayResY: {H}
WrapStyle: 0
ScaledBorderAndShadow: yes

[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Cap,{font_family},104,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H78000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,8,4,2,70,70,330,1
Style: Title,{font_family},128,&H0000E5FF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H78000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,9,4,8,60,60,170,1

[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
""" + "\n".join(events) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


# ---------- 3. video ----------
def build_video(case, scenes, scene_start, total, work: Path):
    order = sorted(scenes)
    listing = []
    for idx, sc in enumerate(order):
        end = scene_start[order[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(order) else total
        n = round((end - scene_start[sc]) * FPS)
        z, x, y = (e.format(n=n) for e in MOVES[MOVE_CYCLE[idx % len(MOVE_CYCLE)]])
        img = ROOT / "images" / case / f"scene_{sc:02d}.png"
        seg = work / f"seg_{sc:02d}.mp4"
        vf = (f"scale={W * 2}:{H * 2}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W * 2}:{H * 2},"
              f"zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={n}:s={W}x{H}:fps={FPS},format=yuv420p")
        run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", img, "-vf", vf, "-frames:v", n, "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "12", seg])
        listing.append(f"file '{seg.name}'")
        print(f"  scene {sc:2d}: {n / FPS:5.2f}s  ({MOVE_CYCLE[idx % len(MOVE_CYCLE)]})")
    (work / "segments.txt").write_text("\n".join(listing), encoding="utf-8")
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", "segments.txt", "-c", "copy", "video.mp4"], cwd=work)
    return work / "video.mp4"


# ---------- 4. audio mix + loudness ----------
def pick_music():
    files = sorted(p for p in MUSIC_DIR.glob("*") if p.suffix.lower() in {".mp3", ".wav", ".m4a", ".ogg"})
    user = [p for p in files if p.name != "mystery_bed.wav"]
    if user:
        return user[0]
    bed = MUSIC_DIR / "mystery_bed.wav"
    if not bed.exists():
        run([sys.executable, ROOT / "scripts" / "gen_music.py"])
    return bed


def build_audio(voice, total, work: Path):
    music = pick_music()
    print(f"  music: {music.name}")
    fc = (f"[0:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,asplit=2[v1][v2];"
          f"[1:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,volume=0.28[m];"
          f"[m][v2]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.03:ratio=6:attack=15:release=350[duck];"
          f"[v1][duck]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,afade=t=out:st={total - 1.5:.2f}:d=1.5[out]")
    mix = work / "mix.wav"
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", voice, "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", music, "-filter_complex", fc,
         "-map", "[out]", "-t", f"{total:.3f}", mix])
    ln = f"loudnorm=I={TARGET_LUFS}:TP=-1.5:LRA=11"
    r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", mix, "-af", ln + ":print_format=json", "-f", "null", "-"])
    m = json.loads(r.stderr[r.stderr.rindex("{"):r.stderr.rindex("}") + 1])
    ln2 = (f"{ln}:measured_I={m['input_i']}:measured_TP={m['input_tp']}:measured_LRA={m['input_lra']}"
           f":measured_thresh={m['input_thresh']}:offset={m['target_offset']}:linear=true,aresample=48000")
    norm = work / "mix_norm.wav"
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", mix, "-af", ln2, "-ar", 48000, norm])
    return norm


def measure_lufs(path):
    r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", path, "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"])
    i = re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1]
    tp = re.findall(r"Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS", r.stderr)[-1]
    return float(i), float(tp)


# ---------- main ----------
def main(case):
    cdir = ROOT / "cases" / case
    lines = json.loads((cdir / "lines.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    meta = json.loads((cdir / "meta.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    scenes = sorted({l["scene"] for l in lines})
    missing = [s for s in scenes if not (ROOT / "images" / case / f"scene_{s:02d}.png").exists()]
    if missing:
        sys.exit(f"Missing scene images: {missing}")

    work = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}_work"
    audio_dir = ROOT / "audio" / case
    for d in (work, audio_dir, work / "fonts"):
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy(FONT, work / "fonts" / FONT.name)
    font_family = ImageFont.truetype(str(FONT)).getname()[0]

    print("1/4 voice")
    voice, total, scene_start, timed = build_voice(lines, audio_dir, work)
    print(f"  total {total:.1f}s")
    if not 45 <= total <= 60:
        print(f"  WARNING: {total:.1f}s is outside 45-60s")

    print("2/4 captions")
    build_ass(timed, scene_start, total, scenes[-1], meta.get("final_title", "बताओ, दोषी कौन?"), font_family, work / "subs.ass")

    print("3/4 video")
    build_video(case, scenes, scene_start, total, work)

    print("4/4 audio + final mux")
    norm = build_audio(voice, total, work)
    out = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}.mp4"
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", "video.mp4", "-i", norm,
         "-vf", "subtitles=subs.ass:fontsdir=fonts", "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "slow", "-crf", "18",
         "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", FPS, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", 48000,
         "-shortest", "-movflags", "+faststart", out], cwd=work)

    lufs, tp = measure_lufs(out)
    txt = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}.txt"
    txt.write_text(
        f"TITLE:\n{meta['title']}\n\nDESCRIPTION:\n{meta['description']}\n\n{' '.join(meta['hashtags'])}\n\n"
        f"PINNED COMMENT (answer, post later):\n{meta['pinned_comment']}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nDONE  {out}  ({total:.1f}s, {lufs:.1f} LUFS, true peak {tp:.1f} dBFS)\n      {txt}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1])

```

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```python
"""Analyse a video's pacing/audio for learning (no content reuse).

Usage: python scripts/analyze_video.py <video> <out_dir> [cuts.txt]
Writes <out_dir>/transcript.txt and prints a JSON summary.
Music-vs-voice and pitch numbers are estimates (no source separation).
"""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FFMPEG = ROOT / "tools" / "ffmpeg" / "ffmpeg.exe"
MODELS = ROOT / "tools" / "whisper-models"
SR = 16000


def load_audio(path):
    raw = subprocess.run([str(FFMPEG), "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(SR), "-f", "s16le", "-"],
                         capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    return np.frombuffer(raw, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768


def db(x):
    return 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2)) + 1e-9)


def f0(seg):
    """Median pitch (Hz) of a speech chunk via autocorrelation, None if unvoiced."""
    win, hop, vals = int(0.04 * SR), int(0.02 * SR), []
    lo, hi = SR // 400, SR // 70
    for i in range(0, len(seg) - win, hop):
        fr = seg[i:i + win] - seg[i:i + win].mean()
        if np.sqrt(np.mean(fr ** 2)) < 0.01:
            continue
        ac = np.correlate(fr, fr, "full")[win - 1:]
        if ac[0] <= 0:
            continue
        lag = lo + int(np.argmax(ac[lo:hi]))
        if ac[lag] / ac[0] > 0.5:
            vals.append(SR / lag)
    return float(np.median(vals)) if len(vals) > 5 else None


def main(video, out_dir, cuts_file=None):
    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    audio = load_audio(video)
    dur = len(audio) / SR

    model = WhisperModel("small", device="cpu", compute_type="int8", download_root=str(MODELS))
    segs, _ = model.transcribe(str(video), language="hi", word_timestamps=True, vad_filter=False, beam_size=1)
    segs = [s for s in segs if s.text.strip()]
    words = [w for s in segs for w in (s.words or [])]
    (out_dir / "transcript.txt").write_text(
        "\n".join(f"[{s.start:7.2f}-{s.end:7.2f}] {s.text.strip()}" for s in segs), encoding="utf-8")

    # pacing
    speech_time = sum(w.end - w.start for w in words)
    gaps = [b.start - a.end for a, b in zip(segs, segs[1:]) if 0 <= b.start - a.end < 5]
    hook = " ".join(w.word.strip() for w in words if w.start < 10)

    # voice vs music level: frames inside words vs frames >=0.3s away from any word
    frame = int(0.05 * SR)
    n = len(audio) // frame
    mask_speech = np.zeros(n, bool)
    mask_near = np.zeros(n, bool)
    for w in words:
        a, b = int(w.start * SR) // frame, int(w.end * SR) // frame + 1
        mask_speech[a:b] = True
        mask_near[max(0, a - 6):b + 6] = True
    frames = audio[: n * frame].reshape(n, frame)
    lev = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt((frames ** 2).mean(1)) + 1e-9)
    speech_db = float(np.median(lev[mask_speech])) if mask_speech.any() else None
    gap_frames = lev[~mask_near]
    music_frames = gap_frames[gap_frames > -55]  # ignore true silence
    music_db = float(np.median(music_frames)) if len(music_frames) else None
    music_presence = float(len(music_frames) / max(1, len(gap_frames)))

    # music level over time (10s windows of non-speech frames) -> big shifts
    shifts, prev = [], None
    for t0 in range(0, int(dur), 10):
        sel = (~mask_near[t0 * 20:(t0 + 10) * 20])
        chunk = lev[t0 * 20:(t0 + 10) * 20][sel]
        chunk = chunk[chunk > -55]
        cur = float(np.median(chunk)) if len(chunk) > 10 else None
        if prev is not None and cur is not None and abs(cur - prev) > 6:
            shifts.append((t0, round(prev, 1), round(cur, 1)))
        prev = cur if cur is not None else prev

    # pitch per segment
    pitches = [p for s in segs if (p := f0(audio[int(s.start * SR):int(s.end * SR)]))]
    bands = {"<140Hz (deep male)": 0, "140-200 (male)": 0, "200-260 (female/high male)": 0, ">260 (child/high)": 0}
    for p in pitches:
        k = list(bands)[0 if p < 140 else 1 if p < 200 else 2 if p < 260 else 3]
        bands[k] += 1

    cuts = []
    if cuts_file and Path(cuts_file).exists():
        cuts = [float(x) for x in Path(cuts_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").split()]
    edges = [0.0] + cuts + [dur]
    shots = np.diff(edges)

    summary = {
        "duration_s": round(dur, 1),
        "cuts": len(cuts),
        "avg_shot_s": round(float(shots.mean()), 2),
        "median_shot_s": round(float(np.median(shots)), 2),
        "avg_shot_first60s": round(float(np.diff([0.0] + [c for c in cuts if c < 60] + [min(60, dur)]).mean()), 2),
        "words": len(words),
        "wpm_overall": round(len(words) / (dur / 60), 1),
        "wpm_while_speaking": round(len(words) / (speech_time / 60), 1) if speech_time else None,
        "hook_first_10s": hook,
        "line_gap_avg_s": round(float(np.mean(gaps)), 2) if gaps else None,
        "line_gap_median_s": round(float(np.median(gaps)), 2) if gaps else None,
        "speech_level_db": round(speech_db, 1) if speech_db is not None else None,
        "music_only_level_db": round(music_db, 1) if music_db is not None else None,
        "music_below_voice_db": round(speech_db - music_db, 1) if speech_db is not None and music_db is not None else None,
        "music_present_in_gaps": round(music_presence, 2),
        "music_level_shifts": shifts[:30],
        "segment_pitch_bands": bands,
        "segment_pitch_median_hz": round(float(np.median(pitches)), 1) if pitches else None,
    }
    (out_dir / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(*sys.argv[1:])

```

| Shuru ke 10 sec ka hook | 2 sec disclaimer, phir narrator gaon aur "रघुवीर लोहार" ka parichay deta hai. Koi sawal ya jhatka nahi. | 2.5 sec me hi samasya: "शर्मा जी की नई साइकिल... रातों-रात गायब!" |
| Lines ke beech gap | ~0.4 sec napa gaya. Teen jagah 10-15 sec sirf music ke emotional pal hain. | 0.52 sec napa gaya (asli 0.3 sec). Sirf music wala koi pal nahi. |
| Music voice se kitna neeche | Sirf ~3 dB (andaza, isme sound effects bhi mile ho sakte hain) | ~19 dB. Hamara music bahut dheema hai. |
| Music kab badalta hai | 5 min me ~7 baar aata-jaata hai, har 20-60 sec me | Ek hi loop, shuru se ant tak same |
| Kitne characters bolte hain | Narrator + 5: Raghuvir, Radha, Ratan, Mukhiya, Bali. Lagbhag 70% lines characters ki, 30% narrator ki. | Narrator + 5: Sharma ji, Golu, Pandey, Dadi, Mitthu. Narrator ke paas 41% shabd hain. Teeno suspects ek bhi shabd nahi bolte. |
| Har character ki alag awaaz | Haan. Pitch me gehri mardana, aurat aur bachche ki awaazein alag dikhti hain, lagta hai alag voice artist hain. | Sirf 2 TTS awaazein, pitch badal kar. Golu aur Mitthu dono Swara jaise lagte hain. |

## Case 01 ke liye 5 sujhaav
1. **Music thoda tez karo aur use kahani ke hisaab se badlo.** Abhi music voice se ~19 dB neeche hai, ise ~10-12 dB neeche laana chahiye. Saath me Golu ke galat guess par ek "comedy sting" aur Dadi ke clue par ek "tension sting" ho. "बताओ, दोषी कौन?" se pehle music 1 sec ke liye ruk jaaye.
2. **Suspects khud bolein.** Narrator se "पप्पू दूधवाला, जो..." kehlwane ki jagah Pappu, Raju aur Bunty apni-apni ek line khud bolein. Isse narrator ka hissa ~41% se ~25% ho jaayega, jaisa reference me hai, aur suspects me jaan aayegi. Shabdon ki ginti 110-140 ke andar hi rahegi.
3. **Har character ki alag awaaz.** edge-tts me kuch "Multilingual" voices hain (jaise Andrew, Ava, Brian, Emma) jo Devanagari padh sakti hain. Main inhe free me test karke sun-ne ke liye samples bana sakta hoon. Accent ajeeb laga toh ElevenLabs jaise paid option ke baare me pehle aapse poochunga.
4. **Narrator thoda dheema karo.** Narrator ki speed +28% se ~+18% karo, Golu ko tez hi rehne do. Video ~55 sec ka ho jaayega, jo limit ke andar hai, aur "Bunty ki ungli" jaisi baatein samajhne ka waqt milega.
5. **Do dramatic ruk-ne wale pal.** Reference me emotional pal par 10-15 sec sirf music chalta hai. Short me iska chhota roop: Dadi ke "रंग ज़रूर लगा होगा" ke baad ~0.8 sec ruk kar laal ungli par zoom, aur last sawal se pehle bhi ek chhota pause.

**Jo humein nahi badalna:**
- **Hook:** hamara hook reference se kahin behtar hai. Wahan disclaimer aur dheema parichay hai, yahan 2 sec me samasya.
- **Tez cuts:** still images ke saath har 2-3 sec ka cut zaroori hai. Reference ke 9 sec ke shots isliye chalte hain kyunki unke characters chalte-firte hain.

**Kya rakha, kya hataya:**
- [scripts/analyze_video.py](scripts/analyze_video.py) aage ke analysis ke liye rakha hai.
- yt-dlp, deno aur Whisper model `tools/` me hain, git me nahi jaate.
- Downloaded video aur audio delete kar diye.

Inme se kaunse sujhaav Case 01 me lagaun? 1, 4 aur 5 free hain aur turant ho sakte hain. 2 ke liye script badalni padegi. 3 ke liye pehle awaaz ke samples bana kar sunaunga.

````text
## Gemini TTS: Key Details

**Model IDs**
- `gemini-3.8-flash-tts` (highest fidelity and expressive control)
- `gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts` (faster and more cost-efficient)

The page also lists older models (`gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview`, `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts`), which don't support voice design or replication.

**REST endpoint**

`POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions`, with the header `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`.

**Single-speaker request body**

```json
{
  "model": "gemini-3.8-flash-tts",
  "input": [{
    "type": "user_input",
    "content": [{
      "type": "text",
      "text": "Have a wonderful day!",
      "annotations": [{
        "type": "speech_metadata",
        "style": "cheerful and friendly"
      }]
    }]
  }],
  "response_format": { "type": "audio" },
  "generation_config": {
    "speech_config": [
      { "voice": "Kore" }
    ]
  }
}
```

Single-speaker `speech_config` is an array. Multi-speaker uses an object with a `speakers` list.

**Response format**
- **Unary requests:** `audio/wav` with a RIFF header, 24 kHz, mono, 16-bit signed little-endian PCM.
- **Streaming requests (`stream: true`):** headerless raw PCM (`audio/l16`), 24 kHz, mono, 16-bit signed little-endian.
- **Other options:** set `response_format.mime_type` to `audio/l16`, `audio/mulaw`, or `audio/alaw`, and optionally `sample_rate` (e.g., 24000, 16000, 8000).

**Prebuilt voices (30 studio voices)**

| Voice | Characteristic | Voice | Characteristic |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zephyr | Bright | Algenib | Gravelly |
| Puck | Upbeat | Rasalgethi | Informative |
| Charon | Informative | Laomedeia | Upbeat |
| Kore | Firm | Achernar | Soft |
| Fenrir | Excitable | Alnilam | Firm |
| Leda | Youthful | Schedar | Even |
| Orus | Firm | Gacrux | Mature |
| Aoede | Breezy | Pulcherrima | Forward |
| Callirrhoe | Easy-going | Achird | Friendly |
| Autonoe | Bright | Zubenelgenubi | Casual |
| Enceladus | Breathy | Vindemiatrix | Gentle |
| Iapetus | Clear | Sadachbia | Lively |
| Umbriel | Easy-going | Sadaltager | Knowledgeable |
| Algieba | Smooth | Sulafat | Warm |
| Despina | Smooth | | |
| Erinome | Clear | | |

The page also mentions an Extended Voice Library of hundreds more voices, which you can list with `GET /v1beta/voices`.

**Hindi (hi-IN)**

Hindi is supported by both current models, according to the language table. The page doesn't mention the `hi-IN` code specifically. The models detect the input language automatically, so no language code appears to be required.

**Controlling style and tone**
- **Turn-level delivery:** put emotion, pace, or tone in `speech_metadata.style`, such as `"whispered urgently"` or `"warm and enthusiastic"`.
- **Point-in-time events:** insert angle-bracket tags in the text, such as `<short pause>`, `<long pause>`, `<laugh>`, `<sigh>`, or `<gasp>`.
- **Verbatim text:** the `text` field is read as a transcript, so keep stage directions out of it.
- **Emphasis:** capitalize key words and use punctuation.
- **Personas:** for consistent voices across requests, design a custom voice in Voice design and reuse its `voice_...` ID with minimal style text.
- **Multi-speaker:** each turn needs a `speaker` value in `speech_metadata` that matches a configured speaker.

**Limits**
- Text-only input and audio-only output.
- A single multi-speaker request supports up to 2 speakers, using prebuilt voices only. Combine custom voices by generating each speaker's turns separately.
- Stateful custom voices: 200 per project, with a 1-year TTL that resets on use.
- Stateless `voicekey_...` voices: 7-day TTL.
- Unary responses include a 44-byte WAV header, so strip it or request `audio/l16` when concatenating turns.
- Use SDK versions `google-genai >= 2.25.0` (Python) or `@google/genai >= 2.24.0` (JavaScript) for the latest features, or use the REST API.
- The page says non-English transcripts still work best with English inline tags.
````

```text
**Text search endpoint and parameters**

- **Endpoint:** `GET /apiv2/search/`. The older `/apiv1/search/text` is deprecated and currently redirects here.
- **`query`:** Search terms. Use `+` or `-` to mark terms as required or excluded, and quotes for phrases. An empty query returns all sounds.
- **`filter`:** Filters use `name:value` pairs separated by spaces. Multi-word values go in double quotes. Numeric ranges use `[start TO end]`, with uppercase `TO`. `OR` and `AND` work inside parentheses.
- **License filter:** `license` is filterable, with the values Attribution, Attribution NonCommercial, and Creative Commons 0. The page has no license example. Based on the multi-word rule, this should work: `filter=license:"Creative Commons 0"`.
- **Duration filter:** `duration` is a numeric filter, so ranges apply, for example `filter=duration:[60 TO 120]`.
- **`sort`:** Options include `score` (default), `duration_asc`/`_desc`, `created_asc`/`_desc`, `downloads_asc`/`_desc`, and `rating_asc`/`_desc`. You can also sort by a numeric target, such as `sort=pitch:220`.
- **`fields`:** A comma-separated list of properties to return. The default is `id,name,tags,username,license`. Setting `fields` removes those defaults, so list everything you need.
- **Paging:** `page` defaults to 1. `page_size` defaults to 15 and caps at 150.

Example: `https://freesound.org/apiv2/search/?query=music&filter=duration:%5B60%20TO%20120%5D&fields=id,name,previews`

**Authentication with an API token**

The page does not describe a token query parameter or a token header for general access. It only says some resources require OAuth2. Its examples send `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`. The Authentication page, which this page links to but which is not included here, would have the details.

**Previews field**

The `previews` object contains these keys:
- `preview-hq-mp3`: about 128 kbps MP3
- `preview-lq-mp3`: about 64 kbps MP3
- `preview-hq-ogg`: about 192 kbps OGG
- `preview-lq-ogg`: about 80 kbps OGG

The page does not say whether preview URLs can be fetched with token authentication.

**Original file download**

Yes, OAuth2 is required. The Download Sound resource (`GET /apiv2/sounds/<sound_id>/download/`) returns the sound in its originally uploaded format and quality, and its example sends a Bearer token. Downloading a whole pack (`/apiv2/packs/<pack_id>/download/`) also requires OAuth2.
```

```python
"""Gemini TTS helper. Key from .env (never printed). Every call is logged to cost_log.csv."""
import base64
import os
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

import cost_log

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")

ENDPOINT = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions"
MODEL = "gemini-3.8-flash-tts"
# USD per 1M tokens (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, checked 2026-10-17; doubles from 2027-01-01)
PRICE_IN, PRICE_OUT = 0.50, 9.00
AUDIO_TOKENS_PER_SEC = 25
SR = 24000


def _find(obj, pred):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        if pred(obj):
            return obj
        for v in obj.values():
            if (hit := _find(v, pred)) is not None:
                return hit
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj:
            if (hit := _find(v, pred)) is not None:
                return hit
    return None


def _usage_tokens(js):
    """(input_tokens, output_tokens) if the response reports usage, else (None, None)."""
    u = _find(js, lambda d: any("token" in k.lower() for k in d) and not d.get("data"))
    if not u:
        return None, None
    get = lambda *names: next((u[k] for k in u for n in names if k.lower() == n), None)
    return get("input_tokens", "total_input_tokens", "prompttokencount"), \
        get("output_tokens", "total_output_tokens", "candidatestokencount")


def speak(text: str, voice: str, style: str, out: Path) -> dict:
    key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("GEMINI_API_KEY missing in .env")
    body = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "input": [{"type": "user_input", "content": [{
            "type": "text", "text": text,
            "annotations": [{"type": "speech_metadata", "style": style}]}]}],
        "response_format": {"type": "audio", "mime_type": "audio/l16", "sample_rate": SR},
        "generation_config": {"speech_config": [{"voice": voice}]},
    }
    r = requests.post(ENDPOINT, json=body, headers={"x-goog-api-key": key}, timeout=90)
    if not r.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini TTS {r.status_code}: {r.text[:500]}")
    js = r.json()
    blob = _find(js, lambda d: d.get("data") and "audio" in str(d.get("type", "")) + str(d.get("mime_type", "")))
    if not blob:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No audio in response: {str(js)[:500]}")
    pcm = base64.b64decode(blob["data"])
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with wave.open(str(out), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1), w.setsampwidth(2), w.setframerate(SR), w.writeframes(pcm)
    secs = len(pcm) / 2 / SR

    tin, tout = _usage_tokens(js)
    estimated = tout is None
    tout = tout if tout is not None else secs * AUDIO_TOKENS_PER_SEC
    tin = tin if tin is not None else (len(text) + len(style)) / 2
    usd = tin / 1e6 * PRICE_IN + tout / 1e6 * PRICE_OUT
    row = cost_log.record_usd(out, MODEL, f"tts {secs:.1f}s{' est' if estimated else ''}", usd)
    return {"seconds": secs, "usd": usd, "row": row, "usage_reported": not estimated}

```

```python
}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    total = 0.0
    for name in sys.argv[1:] or list(CAST):
        voice, style, line = CAST[name]
        out = OUT / f"{name}_{voice}.wav"
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            res = speak(line, voice, style, out)
        except Exception as e:

            continue
        total += res["usd"]
        print(f"{name:9s} {voice:14s} {res['seconds']:4.1f}s audio, {time.time() - t0:4.1f}s wait  "
              f"usage={'reported' if res['usage_reported'] else 'estimated'}  "
              + cost_log.summary(res["row"], "sample"), flush=True)
    print(f"TOTAL ${total:.4f} = ₹{total * cost_log.USD_TO_INR:.2f}")
```

```python
import numpy as np

from analyze_video import f0, MODELS  # noqa: E402
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel  # noqa: E402

    x = np.frombuffer(raw, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768

    pf = f0(x)
    print(f"{p.stem:24s} pitch={round(pf) if pf else '-'}Hz | {txt}", flush=True)
```

```python
"""Download CC0 sound-effect candidates from Freesound (HQ previews, token auth).

Usage: python scripts/fetch_sfx.py
Output: assets/sfx/<kind>_<id>.mp3 + assets/sfx/CREDITS.md (CC0: no attribution needed, kept for records)
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
OUT = ROOT / "assets" / "sfx"
API = "https://freesound.org/apiv2/search/"

WANT = {
    "comedy_sting": "cartoon comedy sting",
    "tension_sting": "suspense sting",
    "whoosh": "whoosh transition",
}
PER_KIND = 2


def main():
    token = os.environ.get("FREESOUND_API_KEY")
    if not token:
        raise SystemExit("FREESOUND_API_KEY missing in .env")
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    credits = ["# Sound effects (Freesound, all CC0)", ""]
    for kind, query in WANT.items():
        r = requests.get(API, params={
            "query": query, "filter": 'license:"Creative Commons 0" duration:[0.3 TO 4]',
            "sort": "rating_desc", "page_size": 10,
            "fields": "id,name,username,license,duration,previews,url,avg_rating,num_downloads",
        }, headers={"Authorization": f"Token {token}"}, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        results = r.json()["results"][:PER_KIND]
        for s in results:
            f = OUT / f"{kind}_{s['id']}.mp3"
            f.write_bytes(requests.get(s["previews"]["preview-hq-mp3"], timeout=60).content)
            line = f"- `{f.name}` — \"{s['name']}\" by {s['username']} ({s['duration']:.1f}s, CC0) {s['url']}"
            credits.append(line)
            print(kind, line)
    (OUT / "CREDITS.md").write_text("\n".join(credits) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```python
def pitch_filter(semitones: float, sr: int = 24000) -> str | None:
    """FFmpeg filter that shifts pitch but keeps duration."""
    if not semitones:
        return None
    f = 2 ** (semitones / 12)
    return f"asetrate={sr * f:.0f},aresample={sr},atempo={1 / f:.5f}"
```

```text
253	    i = re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1]
254	    tp = re.findall(r"Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS", r.stderr)[-1]
255	    return float(i), float(tp)
256	
257	
258	# ---------- main ----------
259	def main(case):
260	    cdir = ROOT / "cases" / case
261	    lines = json.loads((cdir / "lines.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
262	    meta = json.loads((cdir / "meta.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
263	    scenes = sorted({l["scene"] for l in lines})
264	    missing = [s for s in scenes if not (ROOT / "images" / case / f"scene_{s:02d}.png").exists()]
265	    if missing:
266	        sys.exit(f"Missing scene images: {missing}")
267	
268	    work = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}_work"
269	    audio_dir = ROOT / "audio" / case
270	    for d in (work, audio_dir, work / "fonts"):
271	        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
272	    shutil.copy(FONT, work / "fonts" / FONT.name)
273	    font_family = ImageFont.truetype(str(FONT)).getname()[0]
274	
275	    print("1/4 voice")
276	    voice, total, scene_start, timed = build_voice(lines, audio_dir, work)
277	    print(f"  total {total:.1f}s")
278	    if not 45 <= total <= 60:
279	        print(f"  WARNING: {total:.1f}s is outside 45-60s")
280	
281	    print("2/4 captions")
282	    build_ass(timed, scene_start, total, scenes[-1], meta.get("final_title", "बताओ, दोषी कौन?"), font_family, work / "subs.ass")
283	
284	    print("3/4 video")
285	    build_video(case, scenes, scene_start, total, work)
286	
287	    print("4/4 audio + final mux")
288	    norm = build_audio(voice, total, work)
289	    out = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}.mp4"
290	    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", "video.mp4", "-i", norm,
291	         "-vf", "subtitles=subs.ass:fontsdir=fonts", "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "slow", "-crf", "18",
292	         "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", FPS, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", 48000,
293	         "-shortest", "-movflags", "+faststart", out], cwd=work)
294	
295	    lufs, tp = measure_lufs(out)
296	    txt = ROOT / "output" / f"{case}.txt"
297	    txt.write_text(
298	        f"TITLE:\n{meta['title']}\n\nDESCRIPTION:\n{meta['description']}\n\n{' '.join(meta['hashtags'])}\n\n"
299	        f"PINNED COMMENT (answer, post later):\n{meta['pinned_comment']}\n", encoding="utf-8")
300	    print(f"\nDONE  {out}  ({total:.1f}s, {lufs:.1f} LUFS, true peak {tp:.1f} dBFS)\n      {txt}")
301	
302	
303	if __name__ == "__main__":
304	    main(sys.argv[1])
305
```

|---|---|

```text
76	def trim_and_time(data: bytes, text: str):
77	    """Trim lead/tail silence by energy; estimate word timings proportionally (Gemini gives none)."""
78	    x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
79	    hop = int(0.01 * SR)
80	    lev = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[: len(x) // hop * hop].reshape(-1, hop) ** 2, axis=1)) + 1e-9)
81	    voiced = np.where(lev > lev.max() - 35)[0]
82	    s0 = max(0, voiced[0] * hop - int(0.01 * SR))
83	    e0 = min(len(x), (voiced[-1] + 1) * hop + int(TAIL * SR))
84	    dur = (e0 - s0) / SR
85	    tokens = text.split()
86	    weights = [len(re.sub(r"[^ऀ-ॿ\w]", "", tok)) + 1 for tok in tokens]
87	    total_w, acc, words = sum(weights), 0.0, []
88	    for tok, wgt in zip(tokens, weights):
89	        a = acc / total_w * dur
90	        acc += wgt
91	        words.append((a, acc / total_w * dur, tok))
92	    return data[s0 * 2:e0 * 2], words

95	def build_voice(lines, audio_dir: Path, work: Path):
96	    pcm, t = bytearray(), 0.0
97	    silence = lambda sec: b"\x00\x00" * int(round(sec * SR))
98	    scene_start, timed, events = {}, [], {"sfx": [], "music_silent": []}
99	    cache = audio_dir / "tts_cache"
100	    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
101	        data = tts_line(line["text"], line["speaker"], cache, audio_dir / f"line_{i + 1:02d}_{line['speaker']}.wav")
102	        data, words = trim_and_time(data, line["text"])
103	        if i:
104	            gap = GAP + line.get("pause_before", 0)
105	            if line.get("music_silent_before"):
106	                events["music_silent"].append((t + GAP / 2, t + gap))
107	            pcm += silence(gap)
108	            t += gap
109	        if line["scene"] not in scene_start:
110	            scene_start[line["scene"]] = 0.0 if i == 0 else t - 0.15
111	        timed.append({**line, "start": t, "words": [(t + a, t + b, w) for a, b, w in words]})
112	        pcm += data
113	        t += len(data) / 2 / SR
114	        if line.get("sfx_after"):
115	            events["sfx"].append((t + 0.05, line["sfx_after"]))
116	        print(f"  line {i + 1:2d} [{line['speaker']:8s}] {len(data) / 2 / SR:5.2f}s")
117	    pcm += silence(END_HOLD)
118	    total = len(pcm) / 2 / SR
119	    voice = work / "voice.wav"
120	    with wave.open(str(voice), "wb") as w:
121	        w.setnchannels(1), w.setsampwidth(2), w.setframerate(SR), w.writeframes(bytes(pcm))
122	    return voice, total, scene_start, timed, events

131	def build_ass(timed, scene_start, total, final_scene, final_title, font_family, path: Path):
132	    events = []
133	    for line in timed:
134	        tokens = line["text"].split()
135	        words = line["words"]

137	            tokens = [w for _, _, w in words]
138	        chunks, cur = [], []
139	        punct = r"[।!?,.…]$"
140	        for j, (tok, (s, e, _)) in enumerate(zip(tokens, words)):
141	            cur.append((tok, s, e))
142	            nxt = tokens[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(tokens) else None
143	            lone_next = nxt is not None and re.search(punct, nxt) and len(cur) < 4  # don't orphan "है!"
144	            if (len(cur) >= 3 and not lone_next) or re.search(punct, tok):
145	                chunks.append(cur)
146	                cur = []
147	        if cur:
148	            chunks.append(cur)

175	def render_shot(img, n, z, x, y, seg):
176	    vf = (f"scale={W * 2}:{H * 2}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W * 2}:{H * 2},"
177	          f"zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={n}:s={W}x{H}:fps={FPS},format=yuv420p")

181	def build_video(case, scenes, scene_start, total, work: Path):
182	    """Each scene = wide shot + close-ups from cases/<case>/shots.json, one shot every ~SHOT_LEN s."""
183	    shots_file = ROOT / "cases" / case / "shots.json"
184	    focus = json.loads(shots_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if shots_file.exists() else {}
185	    order = sorted(scenes)
186	    listing, jobs = [], []
187	    for idx, sc in enumerate(order):
188	        end = scene_start[order[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(order) else total
189	        frames =round((end - scene_start[sc]) * FPS)
190	        closes = focus.get(str(sc), [])
191	        cycle = ["wide"] + closes
192	        n_shots = max(2 if closes else 1, round(frames / FPS / SHOT_LEN))
193	        n_shots = max(1, min(n_shots, int(frames / FPS / MIN_SHOT)))
194	        if n_shots == 1 and closes:  # too short for wide + close: the close-up (face/clue) matters more
195	            cycle = closes
196	        img = ROOT / "images" / case / f"scene_{sc:02d}.png"
197	        bounds = [round(frames * k / n_shots) for k in range(n_shots + 1)]
198	        desc = []
199	        for k in range(n_shots):
200	            n = bounds[k + 1] - bounds[k]
201	            shot = cycle[k % len(cycle)]
202	            if shot == "wide":
203	                move = MOVE_CYCLE[(idx + k) % len(MOVE_CYCLE)]
204	                z, x, y = (e.format(n=n) for e in MOVES[move])
205	                desc.append(move)
206	            else:
207	                fx, fy, zc = shot
208	                z = f"{zc}+{zc * 0.06:.3f}*on/{n}"  # slow push-in on the close-up
209	                x = f"max(0,min(iw-iw/zoom,{fx}*iw-iw/zoom/2))"
210	                y = f"max(0,min(ih-ih/zoom,{fy}*ih-ih/zoom/2))"
211	                desc.append(f"close{zc}")
212	            seg = work / f"seg_{sc:02d}_{k}.mp4"
213	            jobs.append((img, n, z, x, y, seg))
214	            listing.append(f"file '{seg.name}'")
215	        print(f"  scene {sc:2d}: {frames / FPS:5.2f}s  {' | '.join(desc)}")
216	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(2, (os.cpu_count() or 4) // 2)) as pool:
217	        list(pool.map(lambda j: render_shot(*j), jobs))
218	    (work / "segments.txt").write_text("\n".join(listing), encoding="utf-8")
219	    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", "segments.txt", "-c", "copy", "video.mp4"], cwd=work)
220	    return work / "video.mp4"
```

make_short.py ko tez karo, aur ye workflow CLAUDE.md me permanent rule bana do.

PART A — Code me badlav:
1. --preview option jodo: 540x960, ffmpeg "-preset ultrafast -crf 30", 24 fps. Sirf check karne ke liye.
2. --final option: 1080x1920, 30 fps, achhi quality. Upload ke liye.
3. Scene cache: har scene ka clip alag file me save karo (cache/<case>/scene_XX_<hash>.mp4). Hash me image, line ka audio, zoom/pan settings aur caption text shamil ho. Agar hash same hai to clip dobara mat banao, seedha cache se jodo.
4. Audio cache: har TTS line pehle se cache hai, wahi rakho. Sirf badli hui line nayi bane.
5. Final jodna "concat" se ho, poori video dobara encode mat karo, sirf audio mix aur captions ka last step chale.
6. Whisper check, frame check aur loudness report sirf --final par chalein, --preview par nahi.
7. Har run ke end me batao: kitne scenes cache se aaye, kitne naye bane, aur total kitne second lage.

PART B — CLAUDE.md me ye rules jodo (heading: "Video build workflow"):
- Koi bhi badlav ho to pehle sirf --preview banao. Final tabhi banao jab main bolun "final banao".
- Sirf badla hua scene ya line dobara banao, baaki cache se lo. Kabhi poori video shuru se mat banao jab tak main na kahun.
- Mere kai badlav ek saath aayein to sab ek hi build me lagao, har badlav par alag build mat chalao.
- Image/TTS par paisa lagne se pehle cost batao. Sirf cache miss par hi paisa lage.
- Build ke baad hamesha batao: preview ya final, scenes cached/naye, time, aur kharcha.

Phir Case 01 ka ek --preview build chala kar batao ki kitne second laga, aur ek scene (jaise Scene 8) ka caption thoda badal kar dobara preview chalao, taaki pata chale ki cache sahi kaam kar raha hai.

```text
64	    voice, style, semis = CAST[speaker]

77	def trim(data: bytes) -> bytes:
78	    """Trim lead/tail silence by energy so the line's voice starts at its first sample."""
79	    x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
80	    hop = int(0.01 * SR)
81	    lev = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[: len(x) // hop * hop].reshape(-1, hop) ** 2, axis=1)) + 1e-9)
82	    voiced = np.where(lev > lev.max() - 35)[0]
83	    s0 = max(0, voiced[0] * hop - int(0.01 * SR))
84	    e0 = min(len(x), (voiced[-1] + 1) * hop + int(TAIL * SR))
85	    return data[s0 * 2:e0 * 2]

95	def word_times(data: bytes, text: str, cache: Path):
96	    """Script tokens timed by Whisper word timestamps (cached per audio). Whisper's spelling may differ from the
97	    script, so timings are mapped through character position; falls back to proportional if Whisper finds nothing."""
98	    global _whisper
99	    tokens = text.split()
100	    dur = len(data) / 2 / SR
101	    key = cache / f"words_{hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()[:16]}.json"
102	    if key.exists():
103	        ww = json.loads(key.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
104	    else:
105	        if _whisper is None:
106	            from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
107	            _whisper = WhisperModel("small", device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
108	                                    download_root=str(ROOT / "tools" / "whisper-models"))
109	        x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
110	        x16 = np.interp(np.arange(0, len(x), SR / 16000), np.arange(len(x)), x).astype(np.float32)
111	        # no initial_prompt: with the script as prompt Whisper sometimes skips words it thinks were already said
112	        segs, _ = _whisper.transcribe(x16, language="hi", word_timestamps=True, beam_size=5)
113	        ww = [(w.start, w.end, w.word.strip()) for s in segs for w in (s.words or []) if _clean_len(w.word)]
114	        key.write_text(json.dumps(ww, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
115	    # only trust Whisper if it heard roughly the whole line (it can drop words)
116	    coverage = sum(_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww) / max(1, sum(_clean_len(t) for t in tokens))
117	    if not 0.75 <= coverage <= 1.35:
118	        ww = []
119	    # character-position -> time curve from Whisper words
120	    if ww:
121	        lens = [_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww]
122	        tot, acc, xs, ts = sum(lens), 0, [], []
123	        for (a, b, _), n in zip(ww, lens):
124	            xs += [acc / tot, (acc + n) / tot]
125	            ts += [a, b]
126	            acc += n
127	        xs[0], xs[-1] = 0.0, 1.0
128	    else:
129	        xs, ts = [0.0, 1.0], [0.0, dur]
130	    lens = [_clean_len(t) + 1 for t in tokens]
131	    tot, acc, words = sum(lens), 0, []
132	    for tok, n in zip(tokens, lens):
133	        words.append((float(np.interp(acc / tot, xs, ts)), float(np.interp((acc + n) / tot, xs, ts)), tok))
134	        acc += n
135	    return words, f"whisper {coverage:.0%}" if ww else f"PROPORTIONAL (whisper coverage {coverage:.0%})"

227	def shot_times(timed, total):
228	    """Per scene: cut points (seconds). A scene starts CUT_LEAD before its first line's voice; inside a scene
229	    every new speaker's line also starts a shot CUT_LEAD early; long stretches are split every ~SHOT_LEN."""
230	    scenes = []

232	        t = 0.0 if i == 0 else line["start"] - CUT_LEAD
233	        if not scenes or scenes[-1][0] != line["scene"]:
234	            scenes.append([line["scene"], [t]])
235	        elif line["speaker"] != timed[i - 1]["speaker"]:
```

```python
"""One command -> full Short (voice, captions, Ken Burns, music, -14 LUFS, metadata).

Usage:  python scripts/make_short.py <case> [--preview | --final] [--spend]
          --preview (default)  540x960, 24 fps, ultrafast: only for checking -> output/<case>_preview.mp4
          --final              1080x1920, 30 fps, good quality + Whisper/frame/loudness checks -> output/<case>.mp4
          --spend              allow paid TTS for lines not in the cache (otherwise the build stops and shows the cost)
Needs:  cases/<case>/lines.json, meta.json, shots.json, images/<case>/scene_XX.png

Caching: every TTS line (audio/<case>/tts_cache) and every scene clip (cache/<case>/scene_XX_<hash>.mp4, captions
burned in) is reused while its inputs are unchanged. The final step only concatenates clips (no re-encode),
mixes the audio and muxes.
```
