# Munshi RULES — Story-Channel

These are the hard rules. If a builder summary, a script or a file disagrees with them, the rule wins and the step is not PASS. Edit this file to add new rules; Munshi reads it fresh every time.

## 1. Budget
- Prepaid Google Cloud budget: ₹500, auto-reload off. Current balance is whatever `cost_log.csv` says.
- Every paid call (Gemini image ≈ ₹3.24 each at 1K, Gemini TTS per line) must be in `cost_log.csv` with date, project, item, ₹.
- No paid call without the user's OK first. A fix that costs money is always ASK, never FIX.
- Flag it if a step cost more than 30% above its estimate (e.g. LONG_01 TTS: estimate ₹4.85, actual ₹6.63).

## 2. Story and characters (from `channel_bible.md`)
- Characters must match their approved sheets: face, clothes, colours, age look. Compare each scene image against the sheet with Read.
- Dadi (Kamla Devi) narrates. Every other character speaks their own lines in their own voice.
- Mitthu (parrot) has no hands: no hand gestures, holding things or pointing with hands.
- Setting: Gulmohar Mohalla. Village kitchens use a mitti ka chulha, never a gas stove.
- The action in each image must match what the line says at that moment (who is holding what, who is talking).

## 3. Audio
- Final loudness: -14 LUFS integrated (±1), true peak ≤ -1.0 dBFS.
- Music sits under the voice: 12–14 dB below for Shorts, up to ~18–20 dB for narration-heavy long videos. If it is quieter than 20 dB under, flag it.
- Mood changes get a crossfade (≥1 s). No sudden music cuts under dialogue.
- No leaked background audio, clicks, or a line cut off mid-word.

## 4. Captions
- One `.srt` per video, Hindi, UTF-8.
- Each caption must appear while that line is being spoken (±0.3 s), over the right character's shot.
- Lines whose timing was estimated rather than taken from Whisper must be listed in the report.

## 5. Video
- Long video: 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, 16:9. Short: 1080×1920, ≤60 s, 9:16.
- Target length is set in the script. Allowed: ±10%, or inside the user's stated range. Anything beyond that is ASK.
- Preview builds (960×540) are only for review. They are never uploaded.

## 6. Thumbnail
- 1280×720, JPG or PNG, ≤ 2 MB.
- Hindi text is rendered by libass/FFmpeg (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by the AI. Zoom in and check matras and joined letters (ड़, दु, क्ष, etc.).
- Text readable on a phone: letter height ≥ ~12% of frame height, high contrast, max ~4 words.
- Thumbnail text must not repeat the title word for word.
- No spoilers: no ending, no twist, no mystery answer.
- Bottom-right corner (~15% × 12%) has nothing important, because YouTube puts the duration there.

## 7. Metadata
- Title ≤ 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Description ≤ 5000 characters.
- Tags total ≤ 500 characters. 3–5 hashtags in the description (the first 3 show above the title; more than 15 and YouTube ignores all of them).
- Every CC BY music track used (e.g. Incompetech / Kevin MacLeod) is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks.
- Mystery (Dadi Jasoos) videos: the answer never goes in the title, description or thumbnail. It goes in the pinned comment 24 h after publishing.
- Made-for-kids and AI-disclosure values come from `munshi/channel_config.json`. Never guess them.

## 8. Publishing
- Default publish time: 7:00 PM IST.
- At least 2 days between two long videos on the same channel. Shorts can go on other days.
- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.

## 9. Safety
- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.

---
name: step-review
description: Stage-by-stage review checklist for Story-Channel videos (script to thumbnail); returns PASS / FIX / ASK. Used by the munshi agent after every production step.
---

# Step review for Story-Channel

Use this after every production step of a video in the Story-Channel project. Always read `munshi/RULES.md` and `channel_bible.md` first. Verify by opening files yourself; never accept a summary as proof.

## General method
1. Identify the project (e.g. `long-videos/long_01`) and the stage just finished.
2. List the files the stage produced and confirm each exists, with size and date.
3. Run the stage checklist below. For every item record what you actually opened or measured.
4. Decide the verdict: PASS (all verified), FIX (free fix needed), ASK (paid fix, story change, or taste call).
5. Report in the munshi format and append one line to `munshi/log.md`.

## Stage checklists

### 1. Script
- Duration estimate vs target (narration ~2.5 words/sec in Hindi; Gemini Dadi voice runs slower, so add ~25%).
- Every line has a speaker that exists in `channel_bible.md` or in the project's character list.
- Opening hook in the first 10 s; moral stated clearly at the end.
- Mystery videos: the clue is fair and visible, and the answer is not in the title.
- Mitthu never does anything that needs hands.

### 2. Scene breakdown (`*_SCENES.md`, `shots.json`)
- Every script line maps to a scene; no scene without a line or a music-only note.
- Shared-image scene pairs have a different crop/zoom that actually shows the subject of the line.
- Image count and cost estimate (₹3.24 each) match the plan.

### 3. Character sheets
- Look at each sheet with Read. Face, clothes, colours, age look match `channel_bible.md` or the approved spec.
- Props are period/setting correct (mitti ka chulha, not gas stove).

### 4. Scene images
- Make or open a contact sheet. Each image: correct characters, matching their sheets; location consistent; the action of the line is visible (who holds what, who is speaking).
- No garbled AI text in the image, no extra fingers or broken faces in the main subject.
- 16:9 for long, 9:16 for shorts.

### 5. Voice samples / TTS
- `ffprobe` every wav: duration > 0, no silence-only files.
- Count TTS files = count of spoken lines in `lines.json`.
- Run Whisper on each line and compare the transcript with its text; list mismatches.
- Cost vs estimate; flag if >30% over.

### 6. Preview build
- `ffprobe`: resolution 960x540, duration vs target.
- Extract one frame per line (mid-line timestamp) and check the right character/scene is on screen.
- Music cue list matches the mood plan; crossfades present.
- Captions: count, and timing of a sample of lines vs Whisper.

### 7. Final build
- `ffprobe`: 1920x1080 (or 1080x1920 for shorts), 30 fps, H.264 + AAC.
- Loudness via `ffmpeg -af ebur128` or loudnorm print: -14 LUFS ±1, true peak <= -1.0 dBFS.
- Music level under voice within the RULES range.
- Same frame-per-line check as preview, at full resolution.
- `.srt` present, UTF-8; lines estimated rather than Whisper-timed are listed.
- Duration within the range the user approved at preview.

### 8. Thumbnail
- 1280x720, <= 2 MB, jpg/png.
- Zoom on the Hindi text: matras and joined letters correct.
- Text large enough for phone (letter height >= ~12% of frame), <= ~4 words, does not repeat the title.
- No spoiler. Bottom-right corner clear. Characters match their sheets.

### 9. Metadata (`meta.json` / `long_XX.txt`)
- Title <= 100 chars, description <= 5000, tags <= 500 chars, 3-5 hashtags.
- Every CC BY music track used is credited.
- Mystery: no answer anywhere; pinned-comment text prepared for after 24 h.
- made_for_kids and AI disclosure taken from `munshi/channel_config.json`.

## Report format
Write in Hinglish, friendly but professional, address the user as "bhai". Keep it short.

STEP / PROJECT / VERDICT line, then: Kya check kiya, Problems (what, where, suggested fix, cost), Agla kadam.

```

name: youtube-publish
description: Upload and schedule an approved Story-Channel video to YouTube with tools/youtube_upload.py, including one-time OAuth setup. Used by the munshi agent after the user approves the final build.
---

# Publish a video to YouTube

Uses `tools/youtube_upload.py` (YouTube Data API v3). Never upload without the user's explicit OK in this conversation.

## One-time setup (guide the user, they do the clicks in Google Cloud Console)
1. Use the same Google Cloud project as Gemini, or a new one. Enable **YouTube Data API v3**.
2. OAuth consent screen: User type External. Add the channel's Google account as a test user. Then **Publish app** (move it to In production). If it stays in Testing, the refresh token expires every 7 days and uploads stop working.
3. Credentials: Create OAuth client ID, type **Desktop app**. Download JSON and save it as `secrets/client_secret.json`. Make sure `secrets/` is in `.gitignore`.
4. `pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib`
5. First real run opens a browser: pick the channel's account, accept the "unverified app" warning (it is the user's own app). Token is saved to `secrets/youtube_token.json`; later runs are silent.
6. Phone-verify the channel in YouTube Studio, otherwise custom thumbnails fail.

## Important limit: unaudited API projects
Videos uploaded through the API from a project that has not passed YouTube's API audit are locked to **private**, and scheduling may not take effect. Until the audit is approved:
- Upload as private (the script does this when `publish_at` is set).
- Tell the user the one Studio step left: open the studio_url and set Schedule / Public.
- Suggest applying for the audit (YouTube API Services audit and quota extension form, free, takes a few weeks). After approval, scheduling becomes fully automatic.
Quota: default 10,000 units/day; one upload costs about 1,600, thumbnail 50, captions 400. Check the current numbers in the docs if uploads fail with quotaExceeded.

## Per-video steps
1. Confirm in `munshi/log.md`: PASS for final build, thumbnail and metadata of this project. Confirm `output/upload_result.json` does not exist.
2. Read `munshi/channel_config.json` for made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id, language, publish time, playlist id. If made_for_kids is null, ASK the user and save the answer there.
3. Pick publish time: next free day at 19:00 IST respecting min_days_between_long (check other projects' upload_result.json).
4. Write `output/upload.json`:
   - title, description, tags (from the approved metadata file)
   - video: final mp4 (never *_preview*)
   - thumbnail, captions (.srt), language "hi", captions_name "Hindi"
   - made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id
   - publish_at like 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30 (or privacy "private" with no publish_at)
   - playlist_id if configured
5. `python tools/youtube_upload.py --job <upload.json> --dry-run`. Fix any PROBLEMS.
6. Show the user: title, publish time IST, made-for-kids, playlist, thumbnail file. Wait for ha/ok.
7. Run without --dry-run. If thumbnail/captions/playlist failed, fix the cause and run with `--extras-only`.
8. Report: video URL, studio URL, what succeeded, and what still needs a click in Studio (schedule if locked private, pinned comment, end screen). Pinning a comment is not possible through the API.
9. Append a PUBLISHED line to `munshi/log.md`.

```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""YouTube uploader for Story-Channel, used by the Munshi agent.

Usage:
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json --dry-run
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job long-videos/long_01/output/upload.json
    python tools/youtube_upload.py --job ... --extras-only   # retry thumbnail/captions/playlist

One-time setup: see the youtube-publish skill. Needs
    pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib
and secrets/client_secret.json (OAuth "Desktop app" client).
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import random
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
except Exception:
    pass

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SECRETS = ROOT / "secrets"
CLIENT_SECRET = SECRETS / "client_secret.json"
TOKEN = SECRETS / "youtube_token.json"
SCOPES = [
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload",
    "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl",  # captions + playlists
]
RETRY_STATUS = {500, 502, 503, 504}
MAX_RETRIES = 8


def resolve(job_path: Path, p):
    if not p:
        return None
    p = Path(p)
    return p if p.is_absolute() else (job_path.parent / p).resolve()


def validate(job: dict, job_path: Path) -> list:
    errs = []
    title = job.get("title", "")
    desc = job.get("description", "")
    tags = job.get("tags", [])
    if not title:
        errs.append("title missing")
    if len(title) > 100:
        errs.append(f"title too long ({len(title)} > 100)")
    if len(desc) > 5000:
        errs.append(f"description too long ({len(desc)} > 5000)")
    for name, val in (("title", title), ("description", desc)):
        if "<" in val or ">" in val:
            errs.append(f"{name} contains < or >")
    if sum(len(t) for t in tags) + max(len(tags) - 1, 0) > 500:
        errs.append("tags exceed 500 characters")
    hashtags = [w for w in desc.split() if w.startswith("#")]
    if len(hashtags) > 15:
        errs.append(f"{len(hashtags)} hashtags in description (>15: YouTube ignores all)")
    if not isinstance(job.get("made_for_kids"), bool):
        errs.append("made_for_kids must be true/false (set it in munshi/channel_config.json)")

    video = resolve(job_path, job.get("video"))
    if not video or not video.exists():
        errs.append(f"video not found: {video}")
    elif "preview" in video.name.lower():
        errs.append("video looks like a preview build; upload final only")

    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
    if thumb:
        if not thumb.exists():
            errs.append(f"thumbnail not found: {thumb}")
        elif thumb.stat().st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
            errs.append("thumbnail larger than 2 MB")
        elif thumb.suffix.lower() not in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"):
            errs.append("thumbnail must be .jpg or .png")

    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
    if srt and not srt.exists():
        errs.append(f"captions not found: {srt}")

    pub = job.get("publish_at")
    if pub:
        try:
            t = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(pub)
            if t.tzinfo is None:
                errs.append("publish_at needs a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30")
            elif t <= dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) + dt.timedelta(minutes=15):
                errs.append("publish_at must be at least 15 minutes in the future")
        except ValueError:
            errs.append("publish_at is not ISO 8601")
    if job.get("privacy", "private") not in ("private", "unlisted", "public"):
        errs.append("privacy must be private, unlisted or public")
    return errs


def get_service():
    from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import InstalledAppFlow
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build

    creds = None
    if TOKEN.exists():
        creds = Credentials.from_authorized_user_file(str(TOKEN), SCOPES)
    if not creds or not creds.valid:
        if creds and creds.expired and creds.refresh_token:
            creds.refresh(Request())
        else:
            if not CLIENT_SECRET.exists():
                sys.exit(f"Missing {CLIENT_SECRET}. Do the one-time setup first.")
            flow = InstalledAppFlow.from_client_secrets_file(str(CLIENT_SECRET), SCOPES)
            creds = flow.run_local_server(port=0)
        SECRETS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        TOKEN.write_text(creds.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
    return build("youtube", "v3", credentials=creds)


def with_retry(fn, label):
    from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError

    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES + 1):
        try:
            return fn()
        except HttpError as e:
            if e.resp.status not in RETRY_STATUS or attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
                raise
        except (ConnectionError, OSError, TimeoutError):
            if attempt == MAX_RETRIES:
                raise
        wait = min(2 ** attempt + random.random(), 60)
        print(f"{label}: retry {attempt + 1} in {wait:.0f}s")
        time.sleep(wait)


def upload_video(yt, job, job_path):
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload

    status = {
        "privacyStatus": job.get("privacy", "private"),
        "selfDeclaredMadeForKids": job["made_for_kids"],
    }
    if "contains_synthetic_media" in job:
        status["containsSyntheticMedia"] = bool(job["contains_synthetic_media"])
    if job.get("publish_at"):
        status["privacyStatus"] = "private"  # required by YouTube for scheduling
        status["publishAt"] = job["publish_at"]

    body = {
        "snippet": {
            "title": job["title"],
            "description": job.get("description", ""),
            "tags": job.get("tags", []),
            "categoryId": str(job.get("category_id", "1")),
            "defaultLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
            "defaultAudioLanguage": job.get("language", "hi"),
        },
        "status": status,
    }
    media = MediaFileUpload(str(resolve(job_path, job["video"])), mimetype="video/mp4",
                            chunksize=8 * 1024 * 1024, resumable=True)
    req = yt.videos().insert(part="snippet,status", body=body, media_body=media)
    response = None
    while response is None:
        st, response = with_retry(req.next_chunk, "upload")
        if st:
            print(f"upload {int(st.progress() * 100)}%")
    return response["id"]


def do_extras(yt, job, job_path, video_id, result):
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload

    thumb = resolve(job_path, job.get("thumbnail"))
    if thumb and not result.get("thumbnail_ok"):
        try:
            mt = "image/png" if thumb.suffix.lower() == ".png" else "image/jpeg"
            with_retry(lambda: yt.thumbnails().set(
                videoId=video_id, media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(thumb), mimetype=mt)).execute(),
                "thumbnail")
            result["thumbnail_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:  # usually: channel not phone-verified
            result["thumbnail_error"] = str(e)[:300]

    srt = resolve(job_path, job.get("captions"))
    if srt and not result.get("captions_ok"):
        try:
            lang = job.get("language", "hi")
            with_retry(lambda: yt.captions().insert(
                part="snippet",
                body={"snippet": {"videoId": video_id, "language": lang,
                                  "name": job.get("captions_name", "Hindi"), "isDraft": False}},
                media_body=MediaFileUpload(str(srt), mimetype="application/octet-stream"),
            ).execute(), "captions")
            result["captions_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:
            result["captions_error"] = str(e)[:300]

    pl = job.get("playlist_id")
    if pl and not result.get("playlist_ok"):
        try:
            with_retry(lambda: yt.playlistItems().insert(
                part="snippet",
                body={"snippet": {"playlistId": pl,
                                  "resourceId": {"kind": "youtube#video", "videoId": video_id}}},
            ).execute(), "playlist")
            result["playlist_ok"] = True
        except Exception as e:
            result["playlist_error"] = str(e)[:300]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--job", required=True, help="path to upload.json")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="validate only, no network")
    ap.add_argument("--extras-only", action="store_true",
                    help="retry thumbnail/captions/playlist for an already uploaded video")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    job_path = Path(args.job).resolve()
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result_path = job_path.parent / "upload_result.json"
    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if result_path.exists() else {}

    errs = validate(job, job_path)
    print("Title:       ", job.get("title"))
    print("Video:       ", resolve(job_path, job.get("video")))
    print("Privacy:     ", "scheduled" if job.get("publish_at") else job.get("privacy", "private"))
    print("Publish at:  ", job.get("publish_at") or "-")
    print("Made for kids:", job.get("made_for_kids"))
    print("Thumbnail:   ", job.get("thumbnail") or "-")
    print("Captions:    ", job.get("captions") or "-")
    print("Playlist:    ", job.get("playlist_id") or "-")
    if errs:
        print("\nPROBLEMS:")
        for e in errs:
            print(" -", e)
        sys.exit(1)
    if args.dry_run:
        print("\nDry run OK. Nothing uploaded.")
        return

    if result.get("video_id") and not args.extras_only:
        sys.exit(f"Already uploaded as {result['video_id']}. Use --extras-only to retry extras.")
    if args.extras_only and not result.get("video_id"):
        sys.exit("No video_id in upload_result.json; nothing to retry.")

    yt = get_service()
    if not result.get("video_id"):
        vid = upload_video(yt, job, job_path)
        result.update({
            "video_id": vid,
            "url": f"https://youtu.be/{vid}",
            "studio_url": f"https://studio.youtube.com/video/{vid}/edit",
            "uploaded_at": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "publish_at": job.get("publish_at"),
        })
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("Uploaded:", result["url"])

    do_extras(yt, job, job_path, result["video_id"], result)
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

   - RULES me setting "Gulmohar Mohalla" likhi hai, jabki Long 01 Rampur gaon me hai. Ye moral stories ke liye chhoot honi chahiye.
   - `long_01.txt` me 7 hashtags hain, jabki RULES 3–5 maangte hain.
   - Thumbnail ka text shayad 12% letter-height se thoda chhota hai. Isse theek karna free hai, sirf text dobara likhna hai.
3. **Munshi agent nayi session me dikhega.** Agents session shuru hote waqt load hote hain, isliye Munshi ko bulane se pehle Claude Code ek baar restart kar lijiye.

## Agla kadam: YouTube API ka one-time setup
Jab aap kahenge, `youtube-publish` skill ke "One-time setup" ke hisaab se ek-ek step karwa dunga:
1. YouTube Data API v3 enable karna
2. OAuth consent screen banana aur app ko "In production" me daalna
3. Desktop OAuth client banana, `secrets/client_secret.json` me save karna
4. Pehla browser login
5. Channel ka phone verification

Ye clicks aapko Google Cloud Console me karne honge. `.env` ya `secrets/` ka content main kabhi print nahi karunga.

```ps1
# Story-Channel -> GitHub sync. Safe to run any time; does nothing if there are no changes.
# Usage: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\sync.ps1 -Message "long_02: final build"
param([string]$Message = "")

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
Set-Location $Root
$LogDir = Join-Path $Root "munshi"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $LogDir | Out-Null
$Log = Join-Path $LogDir "sync.log"
$MaxBytes = 50MB

function Log([string]$m) {
    $line = "{0}  {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $m
    Add-Content -Path $Log -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host $line
}

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Root ".git"))) { Log "ERROR: not a git repo, run deploy.ps1 first"; exit 1 }

# one sync at a time
$Lock = Join-Path $Root ".git\sync.lock"
if ((Test-Path $Lock) -and ((Get-Item $Lock).LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-30))) {
    Log "another sync is running, skipped"; exit 0
}
New-Item -ItemType File -Force $Lock | Out-Null

try {
    # 1. copy user-level Claude setup (agents, skills, CLAUDE.md...) into claude-home/
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "export_claude_home.ps1")

    # 2. keep .env.example in sync: key names only, never values
    $envFile = Join-Path $Root ".env"
    if (Test-Path $envFile) {
        $keys = Get-Content $envFile | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=' } |
            ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '=', 2)[0].Trim() + "=" }
        Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $Root ".env.example") -Value $keys -Encoding UTF8
    }

    git -c core.quotepath=false add -A

    # 3. secret guard: abort if anything secret-looking got staged
    $staged = @(git -c core.quotepath=false diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=AM)
    $bad = $staged | Where-Object { $_ -match '(^|/)\.env$|^secrets/|client_secret.*\.json$|youtube_token\.json$|\.credentials\.json$' }
    if ($bad) {
        git reset -q
        Log ("ABORTED: secret file was about to be pushed: " + ($bad -join ", ") + ". Fix .gitignore.")
        exit 1
    }

    # 4. size guard: unstage files over 50 MB (GitHub blocks >100 MB)
    foreach ($f in $staged) {
        $p = Join-Path $Root $f
        if ((Test-Path $p) -and ((Get-Item $p).Length -gt $MaxBytes)) {
            git reset -q -- "$f"
            Log ("SKIPPED big file (>50MB): " + $f)
        }
    }

    git diff --cached --quiet
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Log "no changes"; exit 0 }

    if (-not $Message) { $Message = "auto sync " + (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") }
    git commit -q -m "$Message"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Log "ERROR: commit failed"; exit 1 }

    git pull -q --rebase --autostash
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        git rebase --abort 2>$null
        Log "ERROR: pull/rebase conflict. Commit is saved locally; ask Claude Code to resolve."
        exit 1
    }
    git push -q
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Log "ERROR: push failed (internet / gh auth?). Commit is saved locally."; exit 1 }

    $kb = [double]((git count-objects -v | Select-String "size-pack").ToString().Split(":")[1].Trim())
    $size = "{0:N0} MB" -f ($kb / 1024)
    Log ("pushed: " + $Message + "  (repo pack size " + $size + ")")
}
finally {
    Remove-Item $Lock -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

```

```ps1
# Copies the user-level Claude Code setup (C:\Users\<you>\.claude) into claude-home/ in the repo.
# Whitelist only: credentials, history, transcripts and caches are never copied.
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$Src = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".claude"
$Dst = Join-Path $Root "claude-home"
$Items = @("CLAUDE.md", "settings.json", "agents", "skills", "commands", "output-styles", "hooks")

if (-not (Test-Path $Src)) { return }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Dst | Out-Null

foreach ($i in $Items) {
    $s = Join-Path $Src $i
    $d = Join-Path $Dst $i
    if (-not (Test-Path $s)) { continue }

    if ($i -eq "settings.json") {
        $txt = Get-Content $s -Raw
        if ($txt -match '(?i)"[A-Z0-9_]*(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)[A-Z0-9_]*"\s*:') {
            Write-Host "settings.json has key/token-like entries; NOT exported. Move secrets to .env."
            continue
        }
    }
    # claude-home/ is a generated mirror, so refresh it fully
    if (Test-Path $d) { Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force }
    Copy-Item $s $d -Recurse -Force
}

```

```ps1
# Story-Channel: set up a NEW Windows system from GitHub in one go.
#
# On a new PC (PowerShell, normal user, not Administrator):
#   1. Get this file (from your GitHub repo page, or your backup copy) and run:
#        powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File deploy.ps1 -Repo yourname/story-channel
#   2. Follow the prompts (GitHub login in browser, API keys once).
# Running it again later is safe: it only fills in what is missing.
param(
    [string]$Repo = "",
    [string]$Path = "D:\Story-Channel"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
function Step([string]$m) { Write-Host ""; Write-Host "==> $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Warn([string]$m) { Write-Host "    ! $m" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
function Have([string]$c) { [bool](Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
function RefreshPath {
    $env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "Machine") + ";" +
                [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User") + ";" +
                (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".local\bin")
}
function WingetInstall([string]$id, [string]$cmd) {
    if (Have $cmd) { Write-Host "    $cmd already installed"; return }
    winget install --id $id -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
    RefreshPath
    if (-not (Have $cmd)) { Warn "$cmd still not found. Close PowerShell, open a new one, run deploy.ps1 again." }
}
function HavePython {
    $p = Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    return ($p -and ($p.Source -notlike "*WindowsApps*"))
}

# If this script already sits inside a cloned repo, use that folder.
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ".git")) { $Path = $PSScriptRoot }

Step "1/10 Basic tools (winget)"
if (-not (Have "winget")) { throw "winget not found. Install 'App Installer' from Microsoft Store, then run again." }
WingetInstall "Git.Git" "git"
WingetInstall "GitHub.cli" "gh"
if (-not (HavePython)) {
    winget install --id Python.Python.3.12 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
    RefreshPath
} else { Write-Host "    python already installed" }
WingetInstall "Gyan.FFmpeg" "ffmpeg"
# EXTRA_TOOLS: Claude Code adds any other tools the pipeline needs here.

Step "2/10 Claude Code"
if (-not (Have "claude")) {
    Invoke-RestMethod https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | Invoke-Expression
    RefreshPath
} else { Write-Host "    claude already installed" }

Step "3/10 GitHub login"
gh auth status 2>$null | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web }
gh auth setup-git

Step "4/10 Project download"
$drive = Split-Path -Qualifier $Path
if (-not (Test-Path $drive)) {
    $Path = Read-Host "Drive $drive is not on this PC. Full folder path for the project (e.g. C:\Story-Channel)"
}
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path ".git")) {
    git -C $Path pull --rebase --autostash
} else {
    if (-not $Repo) { $Repo = Read-Host "GitHub repo (e.g. yourname/story-channel)" }
    gh repo clone $Repo $Path
}
Set-Location $Path

Step "5/10 Git identity"
if (-not (git config --global user.name)) {
    git config --global user.name (Read-Host "Your name for git commits")
}
if (-not (git config --global user.email)) {
    git config --global user.email (Read-Host "Your email for git commits")
}

Step "6/10 Python packages (whisper/torch can take a while)"
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
if (Test-Path "requirements.txt") { python -m pip install -r requirements.txt }

Step "7/10 Fonts"
$fontDir = Join-Path $Path "fonts"
if (Test-Path $fontDir) {
    $userFonts = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Microsoft\Windows\Fonts"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $userFonts | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem $fontDir -Include *.ttf, *.otf -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
        $target = Join-Path $userFonts $_.Name
        if (-not (Test-Path $target)) {
            Copy-Item $_.FullName $target
            New-ItemProperty -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Fonts" `
                -Name $_.BaseName -Value $target -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
            Write-Host "    font installed: $($_.Name)"
        }
    }
}

Step "8/10 Claude setup (agents, skills, CLAUDE.md) -> $env:USERPROFILE\.claude"
$home2 = Join-Path $Path "claude-home"
$dst = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".claude"
if (Test-Path $home2) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dst | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem $home2 | ForEach-Object {
        $t = Join-Path $dst $_.Name
        if (Test-Path $t) {
            $bak = "$t.bak-" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss")
            Rename-Item $t $bak
            Write-Host "    existing $($_.Name) kept as $bak"
        }
        Copy-Item $_.FullName $t -Recurse -Force
    }
}

Step "9/10 Secrets (.env, secrets\)"
$envFile = Join-Path $Path ".env"
if (-not (Test-Path $envFile)) {
    $lines = @()
    $keys = @()
    if (Test-Path ".env.example") {
        $keys = Get-Content ".env.example" | Where-Object { $_ -match '=' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '=', 2)[0].Trim() }
    }
    foreach ($k in $keys) {
        $s = Read-Host "Value for $k (input hidden)" -AsSecureString
        $plain = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto(
            [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($s))
        $lines += "$k=$plain"
    }
    Set-Content -Path $envFile -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host "    .env created with $($keys.Count) keys"
} else { Write-Host "    .env already present" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $Path "secrets") | Out-Null
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Path "secrets\client_secret.json"))) {
    Warn "secrets\client_secret.json missing. Copy it from your backup, or download again: Google Cloud Console > Credentials > your Desktop OAuth client > Download JSON."
    Warn "YouTube login (youtube_token.json) will be asked again on the first upload. That is normal."
}

Step "10/10 Nightly auto-sync + checks"
try {
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "powershell.exe" `
        -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File `"$Path\tools\sync.ps1`" -Message `"nightly sync`""
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 11:30pm
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -StartWhenAvailable
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName "StoryChannel-Sync" -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "    nightly sync task: 11:30 PM (runs later if PC was off)"
} catch { Warn "Could not create the nightly task: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

Write-Host ""
foreach ($c in @("git", "gh", "python", "ffmpeg", "claude")) {
    if (Have $c) { Write-Host ("    OK   " + $c) -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ("    MISSING " + $c) -ForegroundColor Red }
}
python -c "import googleapiclient, google_auth_oauthlib; print('    OK   youtube libs')"
if (Test-Path "tools\youtube_upload.py") { python -m py_compile tools\youtube_upload.py; Write-Host "    OK   youtube_upload.py" }

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Done. Next: open a new terminal, then:  cd `"$Path`"  and run  claude  (log in once)." -ForegroundColor Cyan

```

Abhi tak ka kaam ho gaya hai. Steps 1–9 poore hain, ab sirf aapke GitHub login ka intezaar hai. Uske baad repo banega aur push hoga.

## Abhi aapko ye karna hai
1. Pehla login code (4340-9D2B) maine band kar diya tha, aur koi account login nahi hua. `ashamim@ami.com` safe hai.
2. **Naya code: `1FF7-B426`** (clipboard me copy hai).
3. Ek **Incognito/InPrivate window** kholiye. Agar normal browser apne aap khul gaya ho toh use band kar dijiye, kyunki usme ami.com wala account login hoga.
4. Incognito window me https://github.com/login/device par jaiye aur apne **personal account** se sign in kijiye.
5. Code daal kar Authorize kijiye.
6. Ho jaye toh yahan "done" likhiye. Main check karunga ki sahi account login hua, phir repo banaunga aur push karunga.

## Ab tak kya hua
| Kadam | Nateeja |
|---|---|
| 1. Git, gh | Install ho gaye: Git 2.55 aur gh 2.102. Identity "Shamim Ali / shamimx.ali@gmail.com" sirf is repo me set ki hai (`--local`), global me nahi, taaki ami.com ke kaam ke repos par asar na pade. |
| 2. Files | `sync.ps1`, `sync_bg.ps1`, `export_claude_home.ps1` aur `deploy.ps1` bilkul diye content ke saath bane. `.gitignore` merge kiya: `tools/` hataya, aur purane `*.png` / `*.mp3` / `output/` bhi hataye, kyunki unki wajah se paid images aur thumbnails repo se bahar reh jaate. |
| 3. Cache | Repo se bahar (free me dobara ban sakte hain): `cache/` (320 MB, scene clips), `*_work/` build temp (~250 MB), `tools/ffmpeg` (485 MB), `tools/whisper-models` (464 MB), `tools/deno` aur `yt-dlp.exe`. **Repo me rahenge (paid):** `tts_cache` (dono projects), saari images, character sheets aur `channel_assets/_work` ki raw Gemini images. |
| 4. requirements.txt | 10 packages, abhi installed versions ke saath. Pipeline ko koi extra non-Python tool nahi chahiye. FFmpeg winget se aata hai, isliye EXTRA_TOOLS khaali hai. |
| 5. Fonts | Mukta pehle se `assets/fonts/` me hai aur scripts ise repo ke andar ke path se lete hain, isliye naye system par bhi milega. Koi badlav nahi kiya. |
| 5b. FFmpeg fallback | 3 scripts me fallback joda: agar `tools/ffmpeg` na mile toh PATH wala ffmpeg use hoga. |
| 6. SessionEnd hook | `.claude/settings.json` naya bana, kyunki ye file pehle nahi thi. |
| 7. CLAUDE.md | "GitHub sync" section jod diya. |
| 8. Syntax check | Chaaron `.ps1` me 0 errors. |
| 9. Dry-run | **393 files, 220.6 MB**. 10 sabse badi files sab `assets/music` ki hain (12.5 MB tak). Kisi file me `.env`, secrets, client_secret, token ya `.mp4` nahi hai, aur kisi tracked file me API key bhi nahi mili. |

**Ek extra exclude:** `claude-home/skills/synced/` (227 files). Ye Claude account ke built-in skills hain jo login karne par apne aap aa jaate hain.
